title: IT Business & Technical Analysis Manager
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
The Finance and Procurement Product Portfolio plays a critical role at the intersection of BCG’s Global Finance and IT functions. Its purpose is to deliver best-in-class financial systems that enable the organization to transact efficiently and responsibly, capture, enrich, and report core financial data to BCG’s business leaders, and comply with the complex fiscal requirements of a multinational organization. The portfolio also ensures that its platforms provide exceptional user experience, aligns with BCG’s global IT enterprise architecture and security standards, and minimizes the total cost of operations. It embraces the latest technologies and Agile ways of working to enhance financial systems and deliver business value at scale.
  
  
BCG’s global finance function is undergoing a major transformation, with technology serving as a core enabler. A key part of this transformation is the deployment of SAP S/4 HANA Public Cloud as the firm’s global ERP platform. This new platform creates exciting opportunities in Global IT Analyst Manager – Finance . In this role, you will work closely with the global finance organization to drive an efficient period-end close through continuous improvement, further expansion of SAP capabilities, increased automation, and the use of cutting-edge technologies such as generative AI. You will ensure the accounting transactions are recorded correctly in system, maintain system configurations with recent business and functional changes.
  
  
To deliver results, you will collaborate with stakeholders, including functional Business Process Owners, to understand business priorities, help them translate them into a product roadmap, prioritize a backlog of enhancements, and build business cases for potential improvement. Leveraging your expertise in finance, accounting, and SAP, and following Agile principles, you will break down enhancements into meaningful segments of work for your squad to deliver and will track progress toward the desired outcomes.
  
  
What You'll Bring
  
  

* Experience as Finance System Manager on SAP Products
* Finance Domain experience with Engineering/Technical background Or a Master’s/MBA finance & accounting
* 7-8yrs experience in SAP S/4 Hana
* Technical and Functional expertise in understanding Finance functional data flows
* A very professional communication and stakeholder management skills
* Certification in SAP ERP or Products would be preferred.

Who You'll Work With
  
  

* Members of your team and external resources across different functional areas
* Functional Business Process Owners, superusers and technical team members translating issues into solutions
* Squad Chapter Lead who will be your line manager and help coordinate work across SAP squads
* Chapter Lead will help setup the vision and roadmap in your workstream and would align the operations engineering squad overall tribe vision set by Technical Area Lead
* Learn and share best practices and ensure alignment between team members and squads

Additional info
  
  
**YOU'RE GOOD AT**
Key Responsibility Areas
  
  

* Production support of SAP Financials (SAP S/4 Hana, Public Cloud) with focus on FI modules within SAP
* Develop detailed understanding of the SAP Financials solution handed over by system integration partner and build capability to manage system configurations.
* Problem Solving attitude and should be capable of performing detailed analysis for complex business problems and provide appropriate solutions to stakeholders
* Identify, Interpret, validate functional specification shared by product development team and create support model
* Conduct sessions with customer to understand the system problems and design requirement gaps document those for product owners to fix and deliver them to end user
* System defects should have experience working with SAP to initiate OSS Cases/Incidents as required escalate and get the hot fixes deployed as needed
* Testing and Release of upgrade related changes in SAP S4 Hana system landscape and align impact of changes on the functional process with process/technical owners
* Understanding about Agile concept of Project Delivery
* Participate in transformation meetings as we go-live in other markets
* Develop Subject Matter Expertise and create knowledge support documentation for mentoring to other team members.

Functional & Technical Expertise
  
  

* Experienced profession with at least 7-8yrs experience as SAP FI Consultant.
* Expert understanding of various components within the Financial Accounting (FI) module such as General Ledger (FI-GL), Asset Accounting (FI-AA), Intercompany, Tax and Enterprise Structure as well as their integration with other SAP Modules like SD, AP would be added advantage.
* Expertise in managing the Month End period close activities with global finance function
* Execute and deploy necessary system configuration changes in SAP as per the business requirements
* Trouble shooting application jobs and fixing system issues
* Deep understanding of the Business Partner concept, Bank Account Management, Cash Position and Cash Flow Analysis
* Experience working on FIORI apps, S/4 HANA preferred
* Certification in SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting is desired

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

title: Software Development Engineer III (Java)
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
   

  

 Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
   

  

**Brief Introduction To The Team**
 The Ordering Team owns the core order orchestration platform for Expedia Group, powering every booking transaction across its brands. The team manages the complete order lifecycle—create, change, and cancel—while integrating with critical downstream systems such as lodging, fraud, and payments.
   

  

 Operating Tier 0/Tier 1 services, the team builds highly scalable, microservices\-based platform capabilities with strict availability and reliability standards. Current initiatives include automating payment installment scheduling for Vrbo and transitioning manual processes into robust, reusable platform solutions.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Design, build, and evolve backend services in Java for core lodging booking, with a focus on reliability, scalability, and performance in a high\-revenue, business\-critical domain.
* Lead migration of functionality from legacy monolithic systems and stored procedures into well\-structured, Spring Boot–based microservices, including supporting API design, low\-level design, and data modeling.
* Apply software design principles, data structures and/or design patterns, and computer science fundamentals to write clean, maintainable, optimized, and modular code with good naming conventions
* Take end\-to\-end ownership of service components in production, including implementation, deployment, monitoring, and incident resolution using cloud platforms and observability tools such as Datadog and Splunk.
* Analyze and improve interactions with RDBMS\-backed data stores, refactoring database logic away from stored procedures into robust service layers while maintaining correctness and system integrity.
* Collaborate with engineers across levels to drive technical decisions, code quality, and best practices in backend engineering, ensuring solutions remain maintainable and extensible across adjacent domains.
* Coordinate cross\-team solutions, welcoming varied perspectives, to develop solutions to issues
* Drive platform engineering features and be an enthusiast for a DevOps environment across the organization in the pursuit to be operationally better every day
* Articulate technical design decisions and software implementation in technical forums
* Participate in code evolution and coding standard methodologies via code reviews
* Safely integrate and operate AI/ML‑enabled tools and solutions in the development lifecycle and production workflows to improve engineering velocity, quality, and operational outcomes, including familiarity with AI\-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products.
* Candidate should have moderate experience mentoring Junior developers.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* 6\+ years of professional software development experience with a strong focus on backend engineering using Java in production environments.
* Hands\-on experience designing and implementing backend services, including system design (with low\-level design), API contracts, and data modeling for RDBMS\-backed applications.
* Practical exposure to at least one major cloud platform (preferably AWS) and associated services for deploying, running, and monitoring backend services at scale.
* Demonstrated responsibility for owning and supporting backend components in production, including working with monitoring, logging, and alerting systems such as Datadog or Splunk.
* Familiarity with AI\-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products in the context of backend service development, testing, or operations.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Deep expertise in Java\-based microservice development using frameworks such as Spring Boot, including experience modernizing legacy or monolithic systems into service\-oriented architectures.
* Strong RDBMS experience that goes beyond basic CRUD usage, including working with stored procedures, performance tuning, and systematically migrating database\-resident logic into application services.
* Experience building and operating large\-scale, business\-critical backend systems in a cloud environment (such as AWS), with a track record of using observability tooling to drive operational excellence and reliability.
* Demonstrated use of AI\-augmented development or operations (for example, code\-generation assistants, intelligent alerting, or anomaly detection) and the ability to safely integrate AI/ML‑enabled solutions into backend services to improve developer productivity, system stability, or customer outcomes.


**Accommodation requests**
 Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service\-now.com/askeg?id\=job\_accommodation.
   

  

**About Expedia Group**
 Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

**Process Overview\***

title: Lead, AI Engineering
description:
*Application submission deadline, 26 October 2026*
**What Makes Us a Great Place To Work**
 We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the \#1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
   

  

**About Bain AI, Insights \& Solutions (AIS)**
 Bain’s AI, Insights \& Solutions (AIS) team works with clients to design and deliver AI\-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into robust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.
   

  

**The Impact You’ll Have**
 Bain works with clients on board\-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step\-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.
   

  

 As an AI Engineer in AIS, you will build the technical core of these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.
   

  

**The Role**
 We are hiring an AI Engineer to build GenAI and agentic AI applications for enterprise use cases, ranging from rapid proofs of concept (POCs) to MVPs and, where appropriate, scaled production deployments. You will design and implement LLM\-driven applications and agentic workflows that use tools, data, and enterprise systems to execute multi\-step tasks reliably and safely. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role with growing influence on technical direction and an opportunity to begin mentoring more junior team members.
   

  

 While GenAI and agentic AI are the primary focus, you will also draw on data science and ML engineering skills as needed, including building evaluation approaches, working with data pipelines, and developing or integrating ML models when they materially improve performance or reliability.
   

  

 You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.
   

  

 Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn by doing, with support from experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Build AI applications that drive real business outcomes**
* Design and develop GenAI applications (e.g., copilots, workflow automation, decision support) using modern LLM stacks.
* Implement agentic workflows where they add clear value (e.g., tool use, multi\-step execution, human\-in\-the\-loop controls), with attention to reliability, safety, and clear failure modes.
* Design and build advanced search, retrieval, and knowledge pipelines across diverse data structures and stores (e.g., hybrid search, vector stores, graph databases/knowledge graphs, and traditional data platforms), covering indexing strategies, metadata design, relevance tuning/reranking, freshness, caching, access controls, and source attribution.
* Build robust agent capabilities including context engineering, memory/state management (short\-term and long\-term), orchestration, routing, and tool integration patterns.
* Integrate solutions into enterprise environments and workflows (APIs, data systems, collaboration tools), balancing quality, latency, cost, privacy, and adoption.
* Translate ambiguous client needs into clear technical requirements, tradeoffs, and delivery plans.


**Build And Apply Data Science And Machine Learning Capabilities**
* Build ML solutions end\-to\-end: data preparation, feature engineering, model selection, training, validation/testing, and performance analysis.
* Apply the right methods for the problem, spanning classical ML and deep learning (including sequence, text, and image models when relevant).
* Create reproducible training and evaluation pipelines (versioning, experiment tracking, robust validation, clear documentation).
* Demonstrate fluency with modern deep learning concepts, including transformer fundamentals and LLM pre\-training vs post\-training concepts (e.g., instruction tuning and preference optimization approaches).


**Engineer for real delivery: POC → MVP → production**
* Write clean, testable, maintainable code and ship AI services through the full SDLC: build → test → deploy → monitor → iterate.
* Implement MLOps and GenAIOps practices: CI/CD, reproducibility, environment parity, model/prompt/agent versioning, and operational readiness.
* Build evaluation and observability for GenAI and agentic systems: tracing and instrumentation, regression test suites, automated scoring where appropriate, and iteration loops for prompt/policy optimization.
* Design for secure enterprise deployment: access controls, auditability, data handling for sensitive/PII data, and responsible AI guardrails.
* Build reusable components and accelerators (templates, evaluation harnesses, connectors, orchestration patterns) that scale across client contexts.


**Thrive in a client\-facing consulting environment**
* Communicate clearly with technical and non\-technical stakeholders; lead working sessions, present recommendations, and write crisp technical documentation.
* Work effectively with Bain consultants to prioritize the critical few technical decisions that unlock business value.
* Support proposal shaping and scoping: effort sizing, architecture options, risk assessment, and delivery roadmaps.


**What We’re Looking For**
* Core engineering \+ AI application skills
+ 3–5\+ years of professional AI / ML engineering experience (or equivalent), with strong backend engineering fundamentals.
+ Strong proficiency in Python and experience building APIs/services (e.g., REST/gRPC) and integrating with enterprise systems.
+ Hands\-on experience building LLM\-powered applications with delivery considerations (latency, cost, reliability, security).
+ Experience building advanced retrieval/search systems (e.g., hybrid retrieval, vector search, reranking), and comfort working across multiple data stores (vector, graph, relational/document/search).
+ Experience implementing agentic patterns (context management, tool integration, orchestration, and memory/state handling) and strong judgment about when agentic approaches are (and are not) appropriate.
+ Strong engineering practices: testing, code review, version control, CI/CD, and performance profiling.

* Cloud, platform, and production delivery experience
+ Experience deploying and operating services on AWS, GCP, and/or Azure (environment management, reliability, observability, scaling).
+ Experience with Docker and Kubernetes (or equivalent orchestration) and operating services in production (debugging, performance, resilience).
+ Proven ability to implement security, privacy, and governance requirements for AI systems (authentication/authorization, access controls, PII/sensitive data handling, enterprise risk controls).

* Breadth of knowledge across data science and machine learning
+ Experience training, validating, and testing ML models; strong understanding of overfitting, generalization, and evaluation methodology.
+ Practical experience with feature engineering and data preprocessing for real\-world datasets.
+ Familiarity with a broad set of ML algorithms (classical ML and deep learning), and the ability to choose methods that match the business and data constraints.
+ Familiarity with deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch/TensorFlow) and ML lifecycle tooling (e.g., experiment tracking, model registry, feature store concepts).

* Delivery mindset and consulting skills
+ Proven ability to operate in ambiguity and complexity, manage priorities, and deliver outcomes independently or with a collaborative team.
+ Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, able to explain technical decisions, tradeoffs, and results to mixed audiences.
+ Strong stakeholder management skills; comfort working directly with clients.

* Working Model \& Travel
+ This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.
+ Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.

title: Market Data Operations Analyst
description:

Through recent strategic acquisitions, Numerix has further strengthened its leadership position, empowering financial institutions worldwide to transform risk into opportunity with confidence. As AI reshapes capital markets technology, Numerix is focused on combining the speed and flexibility of AI with the deterministic, auditable, and governed calculations that financial institutions require.
 



  





 We are seeking a
 **Market Data Operations Analyst** 
 to support Numerix SaaS clients by monitoring market data generation processes used by Numerix Financial Systems to ensure the integrity and the quality of market data as part of Numerix Data Management (NXDM) framework. This role involves technical and functional support, incident management, and coordination with clients and internal teams (P\&E, PS, etc.), contributing directly to operational excellence and client satisfaction.
 



  





  





**What You'll Do:** 



* Define, implement, and execute standard operating procedures for Numerix clients’ market data operation processes.

* Enhance existing processes through optimization and automation of manual checks.
* Respond to daily requests for operational support activities related to market data queries, raised by both our clients and internal groups.
* Monitor, triage, and resolve technical and data quality issues related to Numerix data feeds, escalating to developers, vendors, or other stakeholders as needed.
* Engage with vendors to address inquiries related to market data availability, delivery or quality.
* Coordinate NXDM releases and production patch deployments with clients, and support development teams in executing and validating parallel runs.
* Act as Incident Manager in accordance with incident management policies for market data incidents, leading Post\-Mortem review and root cause analysis to drive continuous improvement.
* Assist Numerix clients (financial institutions) with our API platform for market data related issues and queries.



  





  





**What We're Looking For:** 



* Bachelor’s degree from a leading engineering university, or equivalent professional experience.
* Good experience in Python for ad\-hoc data analysis and automating manual processes.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel; practical exposure to SQL is beneficial for the role.
* Understanding of exchange\-traded and OTC derivatives (e.g., forwards, futures, options) across multiple asset classes, including IR, commodities, credit, equities, and FX. Familiarity with financial concepts such as volatility and beta is advantageous.
* Working Knowledge of Cloud Services, ideally AWS (Step Functions, Lambda, EC2, DynamoDB, etc.) is a plus.
* Strong troubleshooting abilities and good English communication skills.
* Willingness to work in US shift when required (3:00 PM to 11:30 PM MST).



  





  





**Extra Credit:** 



* Understanding of multiple asset classes (IR, Commodities, Credit, Equities, FX).
* Ability to use Excel, Python and SQL for ad\-hoc data analysis and investigation of market data issues.



  





  





**Where You’ll Work:** 




 This is a fully remote role open to anyone who is authorized to work in India.
 



  





  





**An important note on salary:** 




 The annual pay range for this position is based on the preferred primary location of the role which is listed above. If you are applying to this role at a location that is not the preferred primary location, please keep in mind the salary range will vary and may fall outside of what is listed. Base pay offered may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience.
 



  





  





***Also note that unsolicited contact from third\-party recruiters or agencies will not be considered at this time. We respectfully request no outreach from agencies.***

title: Staff Engineer
description:
MongoDB's Application Modernization Platform (AMP) helps organizations modernize legacy applications and move their workloads and associated data from relational databases to MongoDB. Our customers need a dependable way to bring analysis, transformation, testing, and migration capabilities into their modernization workflows.
   

  

 The Platform team builds the shared foundations that make AMP a cohesive product. We connect specialized tools and services through consistent interfaces, integrate them with AI agents and development environments, and make them secure, observable, and straightforward to deploy and operate. You will combine deep systems engineering with product judgment, turning ambiguous requirements into reusable services and working integrations. You will define clear boundaries between platform, product teams, and external partners; make deliberate build\-versus\-integrate decisions; and contribute foundational code. Your impact will be measured by how reliably teams and customers can adopt and use AMP capabilities, and how much engineering effort the platform removes from their path.

* Technical Leadership: Over 8 years in software engineering and production operations, with a proven history of championing major technical strategies and deploying resilient, scalable architectures

 Position Expectations
   

  

* Architectural Vision \& Strategy: Formulate core service layers and integration frameworks enabling seamless AMP functionality. Define strict service\-level boundaries with collaborating engineering orgs, iteratively maturing platform primitives using production workloads
* Agent \& Tooling Integration: Spearhead engineering initiatives to expose platform capabilities via resilient CLI tools and APIs, connecting them cleanly with autonomous agent frameworks while managing tenant isolation, auth state, and operational context
* Deployment \& Lifecycle Engineering: Optimize distribution, automated upgrades, and runtime execution across client enterprise environments. Establish holistic telemetry, structured logging, and actionable diagnostics to streamline incident recovery and troubleshooting
* Security \& Enterprise Quality: Work closely alongside security engineers to safeguard customer intellectual property, ensuring robust execution isolation and embedding security controls directly into release pipelines
* Cross\-Functional Strategy Execution: Align product management, field teams, and external technical partners to translate user demands into high\-impact roadmaps, driving implementation from discovery through widespread client adoption
* Technical Leadership \& Excellence: Author core infrastructure components, lead rigorous architectural reviews, and elevate team capabilities through shared design paradigms, thorough documentation, and hands\-on mentoring


 Success Measures
   

  

 3 Months Objectives:
   

  

* Develop comprehensive mastery of system architectures, user journeys, and technical constraints while fostering key cross\-functional partnerships
* Unify stakeholders around a strategic engineering initiative, defining architectural boundaries, delivery roadmaps, and baseline operational metrics
* Deploy a high\-impact core component that validates key design paradigms and eliminates key operational friction for internal adopters


 6 Months Objectives:
   

  

* Spearhead production rollout of major shared services with defined interfaces, comprehensive telemetry, and sustainable operational framework support
* Drive quantifiable progress in target performance indicators, including onboarding speed, integration complexity, system resilience, and mean time to resolution
* Influence overall technical direction alongside product partners, establishing systematic cadences for architectural reviews and execution milestones


 12 Months Objectives:
   

  

* Establish foundational platform primitives powering enterprise\-wide capabilities, ensuring high\-availability operations and seamless upgrade paths
* Demonstrate tangible efficiency gains across product teams by significantly lowering maintenance overhead and accelerating modernization deployment speed
* Serve as a key technical champion, mentoring talent, elevating engineering standards, and participating actively in talent acquisition

Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
   

  

**Introduction To The Team**
 The
 **Air Filters \& Ranking** 
 team at Expedia Group sits at the heart of how travelers discover and select flights. We are a backend‑focused, data‑driven team that builds the intelligence behind flight search results—ensuring that millions of customers around the world can find the right itinerary quickly, confidently, and at scale.
   

  

**What We Build**
 Our team owns and evolves the
 **Flights Central Tool** 
 , as well as the
 **filters** 
 and
 **ranking** 
 systems that shape what travelers see on the flight search results page.
   

  

**Flights Central Tool**
 We provide a central control plane for flight experiences: configuration, feature flags, experiments, and insights that let product, analytics, and operations teams fine‑tune how flight offers are selected and presented. This tool is the hub where business strategy meets technical execution for air.
   

  

**Ranking \& Offer Selection**
 We integrate
 **ML models at multiple layers** 
 of the stack to score, blend, and rank flight offers in real time. Our goal is to surface the most relevant options—balancing price, convenience, reliability, flexibility, and traveler preferences—so that customers see compelling choices at the very top of the results.
   

  

**Filters \& Intent Understanding**
 We design and power flight filters (e.g., stops, times, airlines, fare attributes, flexibility) so that travelers can narrow hundreds of itineraries down to a small, manageable set. We are increasingly
 **intent‑aware** 
 , using behavior and context to order and apply filters in ways that speed up decision‑making.

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain high\-quality software that delivers reliable, accessible, and intuitive customer experiences.

* Contribute to low\-level system design, API design, and data modeling to support maintainable, resilient, secure, and operationally reliable applications.

* Stakeholder Collaboration

* Proven experience leading or managing data migration activities.
* Understanding of data migration processes, including data extraction, transformation, cleansing, validation, and reconciliation.
* Experience working with global templates, governance frameworks, and standardized deployment models.

* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work effectively across global, regional, and cross\-functional teams.


****Preferred Qualifications****
* Experience in the automotive industry or a related manufacturing environment.
* Experience with Global Data Factory methodologies or similar enterprise data governance programs.
* Familiarity with SAP integration technologies and enterprise application landscapes.
* Experience supporting SAP program deployments across multiple countries or regions.
* Knowledge of SAP Activate or comparable implementation methodologies.
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Engineering, or a related field.


**Core Competencies**
* SAP S/4HANA architecture
* Data migration leadership
* Enterprise application integration
* Technical solution design
* SAP governance and standards
* Clean core strategy
* Regional deployment coordination
* Stakeholder and vendor management
* Risk assessment and issue resolution
* Strategic and analytical thinking

description:

 We are seeking a Senior Blackboard Learn Ultra Consultant to take full technical and functional ownership of a live Blackboard Learn Ultra environment.
 



 The successful candidate will act as the single point of delivery accountability, working closely with IT, academic affairs, registrar teams, faculty, and other stakeholders.
 



  





**The engagement will focus on four key areas:** 




  





**Stabilize → Optimize → Enable → Transfer** 




 The consultant will be responsible for platform stabilization, data and access remediation, identity/SIS integrations, Ultra configuration, course and assessment standardization, faculty enablement, operational support, documentation, and knowledge transfer.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**1\. Platform Assessment \& Mobilization** 



* Conduct stakeholder interviews and establish project scope and priorities.
* Assess Production, Test/Stage and approved Blackboard environments.
* Inventory configurations, licenses, users, courses, integrations, authentication, reports, support processes, and security/accessibility controls.
* Establish a prioritized remediation backlog with risks, dependencies, owners, timelines, and acceptance criteria.
* Establish appropriate testing, backup, rollback, approval, and change\-management procedures.



**2\. Data, Access \& Integration Remediation** 



* Profile and cleanse Blackboard users, courses, enrollments, terms, roles, organizations, hierarchy nodes, files, archives, and related data.
* Identify and resolve duplicate, orphaned, invalid, stale, or incorrectly configured records.
* Review privileged, manual, guest, service, inactive, and direct\-access accounts.
* Develop and maintain a role\-to\-privilege matrix.
* Review and improve joiner/mover/leaver and access\-review processes.
* Stabilize identity and integration feeds, including reconciliation, monitoring, alerting, recovery, and backfill.
* Develop positive, negative, boundary, and volume test scenarios to prevent unintended data or enrollment changes.



**3\. Blackboard Ultra Administration \& Security**

* Configure and enable approved Blackboard Ultra capabilities.
* Review Ultra course configuration, Original Course View migration, system roles, SSO/MFA, service accounts, REST/LTI privileges, and integrations.

* Establish Test/Stage\-to\-Production release and regression\-testing processes.
* Provide recurring platform readiness and operational reporting.
* Support cybersecurity, privacy, accessibility, and WCAG/Ally\-type requirements.



**4\. Course Templates, Assessments \& CLO Mapping** 



* Design and implement institutional Blackboard Ultra course templates and approved variants.

* Configure Learning Outcomes/CLO hierarchies.

* User access

* Content
* Gradebook
* Assessments
* Integrations
* Data feeds
* Reporting
* Own technical and functional issues through resolution, including vendor escalation when required.
* Deliver faculty workshops, hands\-on course\-building clinics, one\-to\-one consultations, showcases, and office hours.
* Provide targeted support during term starts and major assessment periods.
* Develop faculty/student guides, onboarding checklists, FAQs, and in\-platform guidance.
* Maintain a searchable knowledge base and known\-error log.
* Produce weekly operational and monthly service reports.

* Architecture documentation
* Configuration documentation
* Data\-flow and field\-mapping documentation
* Data dictionary
* Role matrix
* Test packs
* Change records
* Runbooks
* Support articles
* Course\-template standards
* Training materials
* Conduct structured shadowing and reverse\-shadowing with the client's administrators and support teams.

* Document residual risks and future improvement opportunities.

**Required Qualifications:** 




  





**Blackboard Experience:** 



* **Minimum 12 years of hands\-on Blackboard Learn experience.**
* At least
 **5 years of experience with Blackboard Learn SaaS and Ultra Experience/Ultra Course View** 
 .



 Higher Education Experience
 


* Minimum
 **two comparable higher\-education engagements** 
 .
* At least one engagement must have been delivered within a
 **complex research university** 
 environment.
* Ability to provide verifiable project scope, dates, outcomes, and references.



 SIS \& Integration Experience
 


* Mandatory hands\-on experience integrating Blackboard with
 **Ellucian Banner or a Banner successor** 
 .

* Be able to read code, and basic coding/scripting ability in one or more languages: Java, Python, Ruby, C, C\+\+, C\#, Javascript, node.js, Go, etc.

 You should possess a genuine desire to help people, the ability to think on your feet and remain calm under pressure while solving problems in real\-time. *You do not need to have prior experience with MongoDB. We can teach you that!*
 Bonus Points

 End\-to\-end BAU (Run) responsibility for the GRM risk tooling ecosystem leveraging Microsoft Azure / Databricks, including:

**VIDUR is our 1st flagship product that is today live in 170\+ cities with 11,000\+ users growing with 30% MoM.**

**KonProz has built enterprise grade AI Agents for clients like Nirmal Bang, NexEdge capital in the domain of Insurance and Wealth sector.** 




**We are looking for a Senior Technology Lead who can take end\-to\-end ownership of our technology — products, infrastructure, engineering team, scalability, security and technical decision\-making.** 




**This is not a role where you will only manage developers or attend sprint meetings.** 




**We need someone who can look at the complete technology ecosystem, understand what can go wrong before it goes wrong, step into difficult situations when required and make sure the technology team keeps moving.** 




**You will work closely with the founders and will gradually become the key technology owner across VIDUR’s products and enterprise solutions.** 




  





**What You Will Own Product \& Technology** 



* Take overall technology ownership across VIDUR’s web, mobile, AI and enterprise products.
* Understand the architecture and dependencies across existing products.
* Work closely with product, business and founders to convert business requirements into practical technology execution.
* Review architecture and make decisions around scalability, reliability and performance.
* Evaluate new technologies, AI models, tools and infrastructure where they can improve the product.







**Infrastructure \& Reliability** 



* Own cloud infrastructure, deployment architecture, databases, APIs, monitoring and system reliability.
* Identify infrastructure risks before they turn into production issues.
* Build proper monitoring, alerts, backups, redundancy and recovery processes.
* Handle critical production issues and exception scenarios with the team.
* Improve system performance, scalability and infrastructure costs as the business grows.

* **Conduct technical interviews and help us hire strong engineers.**
* **Mentor developers and improve engineering standards across the team.**

* **Engineering Processes**
* **Establish strong standards around code quality, code reviews, documentation, testing and releases.**
* **Ensure that products are being built with long\-term maintainability in mind.**
* **Create clear development, deployment and incident\-management processes.**
* **Maintain visibility over technical debt and make sure critical issues do not keep getting postponed.**
* **Challenge technical decisions when there is a better or more scalable approach. Risk \& Problem Solving**

* **Identify technology red flags before they become business problems.**
* **Think through failure and exception scenarios while building products.**
* Ask “what happens if this fails?” before something goes live.
* Take ownership during production incidents instead of passing responsibility between teams.
* Understand root causes rather than applying temporary fixes.
* Balance speed of execution with stability and long\-term architecture.
* **Enterprise \& Leadership Exposure**
* **As VIDUR grows, you will also represent the technology function externally. You should be comfortable:**
* **Joining technical discussions with enterprise clients.**
* **Understanding enterprise requirements around integrations, APIs, security, infrastructure and**
* **data.**
* **Explaining our technology architecture in simple business language.**
* **Participating in technology discussions with investors and potential strategic partners.**
* **Responding confidently to technical due\-diligence questions.**
* **Working with founders on technology roadmap, product roadmap and future team requirements.**
* **You do not need to be a salesperson, but you should be able to represent the technology behind VIDUR confidently.**
* **What We Are Looking For**
* **We are looking for someone with 5–9 years of strong technology experience, preferably involving SaaS, AI products, fintech, tax\-tech, consulting\-tech enterprise software or high\-scale B2B platforms.**



  





**You should have:** 



* **Strong understanding of modern web application architecture.**
* **Good understanding of backend systems, APIs, databases and cloud infrastructure.**
* **Experience working with AWS / Azure / GCP or similar cloud environments.**
* **Understanding of system scalability, security, monitoring and reliability.**
* **Experience managing or mentoring developers.**
* **Ability to review architecture and code even if you are not coding every feature yourself.**
* **Experience handling production systems and real\-world failures.**
* Ability to conduct technical interviews and evaluate engineering talent (How has lifecycle
* changed from SDLC to ADLC).
* Strong communication skills for discussions with founders, investors and enterprise clients.
* Experience working with AI/LLMs, RAG, vector databases, document processing or AI\-native products would be a strong advantage.
* More Important Than the Tech Stack
* We care significantly about how you think. We want someone who:
* Thinks like an owner aka family;
* Takes responsibility when something breaks.
* Challenges assumptions instead of blindly executing requirements.
* Can operate with ambiguity.
* Is comfortable making decisions.
* Flags risks early, even when nobody has asked about them.
* Can go deep into a technical issue when required.
* Understands both technology and its business impact.
* Is willing to take on difficult problems.
* Can build systems and teams, not just features.
* If your first question when something goes wrong is “Who is responsible for this?”, this may not be the right role.
* If your first question is “What happened, how do we fix it, and how do we ensure it does not happen again?”, we would like to speak with you.

* Have a strong understanding of the complete VIDUR technology architecture.

* Create better visibility over system performance and reliability.
* Build stronger engineering processes.
* Identify and close important skill gaps within the technology team.
* Improve the quality and speed of product releases.
* Create a scalable technical roadmap for future VIDUR products.
* Become the go\-to technology person for founders, enterprise clients and the engineering team.

title: Manager – ERP Implementation/Transformation Readiness, PI - Global Capability Center
description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez \& Marsal**
 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results\-oriented professionals. We take a hands\-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A\&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity \- are why our people love working at A\&M.
   

  

**The Team**
 Our Performance Improvement team provides Business Transformation and Performance Improvement Services to Corporates, Investors, and their portfolio companies, delivering –
   

  

* Performance improvement via cost reduction and revenue growth programmes
* Large, complex organizational restructuring and business transformation
* Rapid Results Program, which helps to quickly and effectively assess business process management risks and identify key areas impeding performance


**How You Will Contribute**
 We are seeking an experienced Manager – ERP Implementation / Transformation Readiness to lead finance preparedness activities ahead of an ERP transformation. The role will assess and prepare the Finance organization, processes, data, master data, controls, reporting, and technology landscape for a successful ERP implementation. The role will work closely with Finance leadership, business process owners, ERP implementation teams, IT, data teams, and other functional workstreams to identify readiness gaps, define remediation actions, and establish the foundation required for a successful implementation. The ideal candidate will have strong FICO functional knowledge, finance transformation experience, business process understanding, and program management capabilities.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Expertise across one or more of the following areas
   

  

* FI/CO Implementation Readiness Assessment
* Lead a comprehensive assessment of the organization's readiness for ERP implementation.
* Assess current\-state FI/CO processes, organizational structures, master data, transactional data, reporting, controls, integrations, and technology landscape.
* Identify key gaps, dependencies, risks, and prerequisites that need to be addressed before implementation.
* Develop a structured FICO readiness roadmap with priorities, owners, timelines, and remediation actions.
* Assess readiness against SAP/Oracle/MS Dynamics 365 capabilities and recommended leading practices.
* Finance Process Readiness
* Assess current finance processes across: General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting, Intercompany Accounting, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis, Period\-end and year\-end close and Management reporting
* Identify process standardization opportunities before ERP implementation.
* Identify manual, spreadsheet\-driven, highly customized, or non\-standard processes that may create implementation risks.
* Define future\-state process principles and readiness requirements.
* Assess the organization's ability to adopt SAP standard functionality and minimize unnecessary customizations.
* Finance Master Data \& Chart of Accounts Readiness
* Assess the quality, consistency, ownership, and governance of key finance master data. Lead readiness assessment for: Chart of Accounts, General Ledger accounts, Cost Centers, Profit Centers, Internal Orders, Customers and Vendors, Fixed Assets, Banks and bank accounts
* Evaluate opportunities for master\-data rationalization and harmonization.
* Assess alignment of the existing Chart of Accounts with the future ERP design.
* Identify duplicate, obsolete, inactive, or poorly governed master data.
* Define data cleansing and remediation requirements before migration.
* Functional Readiness
* Assess the organization's preparedness for key capabilities, including:
* Universal Journal / ACDOCA (in case of S4HANA), New Asset Accounting, Business Partner, Parallel ledgers, Multiple currencies, Profitability Analysis, Fiori\-based finance processes, Embedded analytics, Intercompany accounting and Centralized finance processes
* Identify implications of moving from legacy ERP environments to current ERP environments.
* Assess existing customizations and determine which should be retired, redesigned, replaced with standard ERP functionality, or retained.
* Support clean\-core readiness assessments.
* Data Migration Readiness
* Lead assessment of finance data migration preparedness.
* Define requirements for historical and open\-item data migration.
* Assess data quality and reconciliation requirements.
* Establish data ownership and accountability across Finance and IT.
* Define cleansing, transformation, mapping, and validation requirements.
* Establish reconciliation principles between legacy systems and new ERP systems.
* Identify data migration risks and dependencies early in the program.
* Integration \& Technology Readiness
* Assess FI/CO dependencies and integration points with: MM, SD, PP, Asset Management, Treasury, Procurement, Sales, Payroll, Banking platforms, Tax systems and Data warehouses and reporting platforms
* Identify upstream and downstream systems that require remediation or redesign.
* Assess interfaces, data flows, integration dependencies, and reconciliation requirements.
* Coordinate with enterprise architecture and technical teams to address integration readiness.
* Reporting \& Management Information Readiness
* Assess existing statutory, management, operational, and regulatory reporting requirements.
* Identify reports dependent on legacy ERP structures, custom tables, or manual data manipulation.
* Map critical reports to the future reporting architecture.
* Assess readiness for analytics and enterprise reporting platforms where applicable.
* Define reporting rationalization opportunities and critical reporting requirements for migration.
* Controls \& Compliance Readiness
* Assess the impact of ERP implementation on finance controls and compliance processes.
* Identify key controls affected by changes to processes, organizational structures, master data, workflows, and system configurations.
* Assess segregation\-of\-duties implications.
* Ensure critical financial controls are incorporated into the future\-state design.
* Support audit, compliance, and control stakeholders in understanding S/4HANA implications.
* Stakeholder \& Program Leadership
* Act as a key interface for the transformation program.
* Partner with CFO organization, Controllers, Finance process owners, IT, ERP implementation teams, and business leadership.
* Lead workshops to assess readiness and agree remediation priorities.
* Present readiness findings, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Manage cross\-functional dependencies and ensure timely resolution of readiness issues.
* Establish governance mechanisms for tracking preparedness activities.
* Team Leadership
* Lead a team of finance transformation professionals.
* Define workplans, deliverables, timelines, and responsibilities.
* Review and ensure quality of readiness assessments and recommendations.
* Coach team members on ERP capabilities, finance processes, and consulting methodologies.
* Coordinate activities across FI/CO, data, integration, reporting, controls, and change management teams.


**Qualifications**
* 6–11 years of experience in ERP transformation and implementation programs
* Experience conducting ERP implementation readiness, assessment, or transformation planning activities.
* Strong experience with SAP / Oracle Fusion / MS Dynamics
* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end Finance processes and their ERP enablement.
* Strong understanding of Chart of Accounts, financial master data, organizational structures, reporting, controls, and data migration.
* Experience working with Finance leadership and senior business stakeholders.
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams and complex transformation workstreams.
* Strong consulting, problem\-solving, presentation, and stakeholder\-management skills.


**Your journey at A\&M**
 We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top\-notch training and on\-the\-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well\-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A\&M. The possibilities are endless for high\-performing and passionate professionals.

**Function:** 
 Data Engineering / AI/ML Platform
 



**Location:** 
 Delhi
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Industry:** 
 Media Production, Broadcast Media, Online Media
 



  





**About Company** 




 The company is one of India's largest private FM radio networks. It reaches over 40 million listeners weekly across 49 cities, 1,000\+ towns, and 50,000 villages.
 



 It is the only private FM station broadcasting from Jammu \& Kashmir, with an international presence in Singapore and Bhutan. Its digital platform extends the brand into curated lifestyle, music, and news content.
 



 The company operates at the intersection of legacy broadcast media and digital innovation, with a team of 740\.
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 The company is building a next\-generation media super\-app that unifies video, audio, radio, micro\-drama, news, and commerce on a single digital platform. This role owns the scalable data and ML infrastructure powering content discovery, personalised recommendations, and user engagement at scale. The engineer in this role bridges production data systems and AI/ML teams, moving models from experimentation into reliable, high\-throughput production environments.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 



* Design and build scalable data architecture for a high\-volume consumer media platform, covering ingestion, transformation, storage, and serving layers for user activity, content consumption, and commerce data.
* Build and maintain batch and real\-time streaming pipelines processing millions of user events and large volumes of multimedia metadata using technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, or Airflow.
* Architect data lakes, warehouses, and analytical datasets supporting product analytics, reporting, and AI/ML use cases; enforce data quality, lineage, observability, and governance across all pipelines.
* Develop feature engineering pipelines and reusable feature stores for recommendation, personalisation, ranking, search, and content intelligence systems.
* Build training and inference pipelines connecting production data with ML models; enable continuous feedback loops for model retraining from live user interactions.
* Deploy ML/AI models into production on AWS, GCP, or Azure; containerise and orchestrate model workloads using Docker and Kubernetes; build APIs/services for consumer\-facing AI integration.
* Monitor model and pipeline performance — latency, scalability, reliability — and partner with AI/ML teams to operationalise models from experimentation to production.



  





**Must Have Criteria** 



* 7–9 years of hands\-on software or data engineering experience, with a track record of building and operating large\-scale data platforms.
* Strong proficiency in Python, Java, or Scala for data and ML pipeline development.
* Production experience with distributed data processing and streaming technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, or Airflow.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud\-based data infrastructure on AWS, GCP, or Azure, including data lakes, warehouses, and distributed storage.
* Demonstrated experience deploying ML/AI models into production environments, including batch and real\-time inference pipelines.
* Proficiency with Docker and Kubernetes for containerising and orchestrating model and pipeline workloads.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, distributed systems, and data modelling for both analytical and ML use cases.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience building data infrastructure for recommendation, personalisation, search, or content ranking systems.
* Exposure to feature stores, MLOps platforms, and ML training/inference workload management.
* Prior experience on high\-scale B2C or consumer internet platforms handling behavioural and event\-streaming data.
* Background in media, OTT, video, audio, music, social media, gaming, or news platforms.
* Exposure to Generative AI, embeddings, vector databases, or LLM\-based applications.



  





**What We Offer** 



* End\-to\-end ownership of data and AI platform infrastructure for a consumer product reaching tens of millions of users.
* Opportunity to work at the convergence of broadcast media and digital innovation on a greenfield super\-app build.
* Collaborative environment with AI/ML, product, and engineering teams working on high\-impact personalisation and content intelligence problems.

description:
****COMPANY PROFILE****
 Bain \& Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.
   

  

 Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefining industries. Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.
   

  

****WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK****
 We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top\-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the \#1 overall spot a record seven times.
   

  

 Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
   

  

****Position Summary****
 The position is in the CRM Team based at Bain’s GBS office in Gurgaon, New Delhi, and is an integral part of the Global Commercial Operations department. CRM is a key tool for the firm’s frontline leaders in pursuing commercial objectives, including relationship cultivation, opportunity management, and account plan execution. The CRM Team enables this pursuit by enhancing the platform, processes, analytics, and user experience that support effective commercial decision\-making.

 **Manager, CRM Optimization \& Innovation** 
 owns core workstreams within the team, driving projects and initiatives across CRM optimization, innovation, analytics, and automation. The role collaborates with senior stakeholders around the globe and independently leads meetings to build alignment, communicate recommendations, and secure buy\-in. The role is responsible for owning and executing end\-to\-end projects focused on process optimization, automation, advanced analytics, and CRM innovation. It requires effective collaboration with team members, internal departments, and product or process owners around the globe. With a focus on driving business outcomes, the Manager advises internal stakeholders on leveraging CRM capabilities and insights to support informed decision\-making. Your role will also involve leading a team of data analysts and ensuring team members are equipped with the tools and skills they need to fulfill their core responsibilities within the team. You will work continuously with senior leadership to manage team capacity and project work, to deliver in a timely fashion. Attention to detail and analytical skills will be critical to success in this role. In addition to partnering with and learning from the key leaders in our business you will have access to the unrivalled support and professional development we offer to all members of the Bain team.
   

  

****Essential Functions:****
**Own projects and initiatives related to advanced analytics**
* Leads a team of data analysts, who are utilizing their advanced technical skills to support complex end user requests that require data to be visualized from multiple sources
* Work with fellow CRM team members to continuously review, optimize and automate current data integrity and enrichment processes using technical tools such as Python, Tableau, Alteryx, SQL, and AI solutions.
* Evaluate best in market tools and provide solutions which will lead to efficiencies (time savings) as well as automation (advancement) on team’s processes.
* Leads projects and initiatives requests relating to data quality often require quick turnaround time. Collaborate closely with the wider Global CRM team and communicate with the senior stakeholders during various phases of these projects or requests including cross\-functional collaboration.


**Invests comprehensively in continuous development of programs**
* Evaluates current CRM design and propose functional improvements in the system to enhance overall user experience. Articulates clear recommendations on how to improve the interface/processes and thus quality of CRM output.
* Utilizes exceptional communication skills to develop programming and deliver insights. Drives necessary process changes and facilitates brainstorming with impacted stakeholders to get to resolve issues and build consensus. Use PowerPoint slides and other technical tools to deliver compelling presentations to senior leadership globally.
* Regularly analyzes processes for improvements and optimization. Identify opportunities for saving overall time and effort used in the process. Innovation \& Continuous Learning: Use newer technology and insights from regular data monitoring to identify and resolve problems.


**People Management**
* Oversee day\-to\-day CRM analytics projects. Collaborates with other senior leaders within the New Delhi GBS office to manage oversight of the entire team.
* Works with senior leadership to ensure regular processes and project work do not exceed team capacity
* Daily task oversight and addressing queries as needs arise with a team of 1\-3 direct reports. Provides daily direction as well as ongoing coaching and evaluation of team, including yearly performance reviews and professional development plans.
* Responsible for overseeing the quality of output of the team members. Identifies areas for operational improvement. Proactively resolve problems and escalate issues to the senior leadership, as necessary.
* Leads team in accordance with Bain’s operating principles encouraging optimum performance and an unwavering focus on results. Maintains transparent two\-way communication.
* Plans required staffing levels to maintain required processes and procedures. Teams with HR and senior leadership to recruit, interview and hire employees.
* Demonstrated ability to understand company policies/practices and be able to explain this information and advice and influence an audience that is not knowledgeable in this area of the business


**Qualification**
**Education**
**Required**
* Bachelor’s degree in business administration \- Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field is required


**Preferred**
* Master’s degree in business administration \- Computer Science, Data Science or a related field is highly preferred


****Experience****
 Required
   

  

* Salesforce experience
* Project management experience is desired, and a formal certification will be an added advantage
* Overall 10\+ years of solid prior experience in enterprise database/information systems


**Preferred**
* Overall 10\+ years of solid prior experience in enterprise database/information systems from a professional services environment


**Required**
**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**
- Experience with:

* Salesforce / CRM
* Advanced SQL

* Python / ML
* AI / Custom GPT / Agentic AI
* Data Analysis

* Able to work closely with teams in other parts of the world, which will require flexible hours.
* Excellent English communication skills, both verbal and written language. The candidate must communicate effectively at all levels of the organization and possess a natural intellectual curiosity about Bain’s business.
* Excellent customer management skills to work with internal global clients. We should work with flawless customer service, diligence, and collaboration across internal teams.
* A strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy. Analyzes trends and monitors problem areas to identify areas for operational improvement.
* Reliable, consistent and mature and able to work independently with a positive attitude.
* Ability to calmly multitask, and learn quickly in a fast\-paced environment
* Ability to deal with ambiguity and develop sustainable solutions to deliver practical results
* Should deepen understanding and knowledge of the consulting industry

title: Microsoft SQL Server Database Administrator
description:
**🌟 We're Hiring: Microsoft SQL Server Database Administrator! 🌟** 




 We are looking for a skilled and proactive Microsoft SQL Server Database Administrator with at least 5 years of experience to join our team. If you are passionate about database management, optimization, and security, this is your chance to make an impact in a dynamic environment.
 



**📍 Location:** 
 Gurugram, India
   

**⏰ Work Mode:** 
 Work from anywhere
   

**💼 Role:** 
 Microsoft SQL Server Database Administrator
 



**What You'll Do:** 




****SQL Development \& Database Design****



* **Develop and maintain complex
 **T\-SQL queries, Stored Procedures, Views, Functions, and database objects** 
 .**
* **Design and modify tables, indexes, constraints, and other database objects.**
* **Write efficient and maintainable SQL for large\-volume transactional systems.**
* **Understand SQL Server query processing and
 **logical execution order of SQL statements** 
 .**
* **Use CTEs, subqueries, window functions, APPLY, temporary tables, table variables, and other appropriate SQL techniques.**
* **Review existing SQL code and identify opportunities for performance and maintainability improvements.**
* **Work closely with developers to improve application/database interaction and scalability.**



****SQL Performance Tuning****



* **Analyse and optimize slow\-running queries and Stored Procedures.**
* **Analyse
 **execution plans** 
 and identify scans, lookups, joins, spills, excessive memory grants, and other performance issues.**
* **Perform index analysis and recommend appropriate indexes.**
* **Troubleshoot
 **blocking, deadlocks, waits, CPU, memory, and I/O\-related issues** 
 .**
* **Analyse SQL Server wait statistics, including waits such as PAGEIOLATCH, CXPACKET, CXSYNC\_PORT, ASYNC\_NETWORK\_IO, etc.**
* **Use
 **Query Store, DMVs, Extended Events, and SQL Server monitoring tools** 
 for performance investigation.**
* **Identify whether performance issues originate from SQL, database design, application behaviour, or infrastructure.**



****SQL Server Administration****



* **Manage SQL Server databases in staging and production environments.**
* **Manage database users, logins, roles, permissions, and security.**
* **Configure and troubleshoot
 **SQL Server Agent Jobs** 
 .**
* **Configure and troubleshoot
 **Linked Servers** 
 .**
* **Manage database\-level configuration and troubleshoot SQL Server configuration issues.**
* **Perform database backup, restore, migration, and recovery activities when required.**
* **Monitor database health, storage, capacity, and performance.**
* **Manage indexes and statistics where appropriate.**
* **Troubleshoot production database incidents and participate in RCA activities.**



****AWS RDS for SQL Server****



* **Strong practical experience with
 **AWS RDS for SQL Server** 
 .**
* **Understand RDS architecture, supported features, and limitations compared with traditional SQL Server.**
* **Work with:**
	+ **RDS Parameter Groups**
	+ **Option Groups**
	+ **Snapshots**
	+ **CloudWatch**
	+ **Performance Insights**
	+ **Storage and IOPS**
	+ **Instance sizing**
* **Monitor and troubleshoot database performance using AWS and SQL Server monitoring tools.**
* **Understand how SQL Server workloads behave within a managed RDS environment.**
* **Troubleshoot issues involving CPU, memory, storage, I/O, connections, waits, and database performance.**
* **Understand which DBA activities are handled by AWS and which activities remain the responsibility of the database/application team.**



****Production Support****



* **Investigate and resolve database\-related production incidents.**
* **Analyse blocking, deadlocks, long\-running queries, resource contention, and application/database performance issues.**
* **Perform root cause analysis and recommend permanent solutions.**
* **Support database deployments, schema changes, and release activities.**
* **Work closely with application developers and DevOps teams during production issues and releases.**



 If you're ready for your next challenge in database administration, apply now! 🚀

 It is the only private FM station broadcasting from Jammu \& Kashmir, with an international presence in Singapore and Bhutan. Its digital platform extends the brand into curated lifestyle, music, and news content.
 



 The company operates at the intersection of legacy broadcast media and digital innovation, with a team of 740\.
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 The company is building a next\-generation media super\-app that unifies video, audio, radio, micro\-drama, news, and commerce on a single digital platform. This role owns the scalable data and ML infrastructure powering content discovery, personalised recommendations, and user engagement at scale. The engineer in this role bridges production data systems and AI/ML teams, moving models from experimentation into reliable, high\-throughput production environments.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 



* Design and build scalable data architecture for a high\-volume consumer media platform, covering ingestion, transformation, storage, and serving layers for user activity, content consumption, and commerce data.
* Build and maintain batch and real\-time streaming pipelines processing millions of user events and large volumes of multimedia metadata using technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, or Airflow.
* Architect data lakes, warehouses, and analytical datasets supporting product analytics, reporting, and AI/ML use cases; enforce data quality, lineage, observability, and governance across all pipelines.
* Develop feature engineering pipelines and reusable feature stores for recommendation, personalisation, ranking, search, and content intelligence systems.
* Build training and inference pipelines connecting production data with ML models; enable continuous feedback loops for model retraining from live user interactions.
* Deploy ML/AI models into production on AWS, GCP, or Azure; containerise and orchestrate model workloads using Docker and Kubernetes; build APIs/services for consumer\-facing AI integration.
* Monitor model and pipeline performance — latency, scalability, reliability — and partner with AI/ML teams to operationalise models from experimentation to production.



  





**Must Have Criteria** 



* 7–9 years of hands\-on software or data engineering experience, with a track record of building and operating large\-scale data platforms.
* Strong proficiency in Python, Java, or Scala for data and ML pipeline development.
* Production experience with distributed data processing and streaming technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, or Airflow.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud\-based data infrastructure on AWS, GCP, or Azure, including data lakes, warehouses, and distributed storage.
* Demonstrated experience deploying ML/AI models into production environments, including batch and real\-time inference pipelines.
* Proficiency with Docker and Kubernetes for containerising and orchestrating model and pipeline workloads.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, distributed systems, and data modelling for both analytical and ML use cases.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience building data infrastructure for recommendation, personalisation, search, or content ranking systems.
* Exposure to feature stores, MLOps platforms, and ML training/inference workload management.
* Prior experience on high\-scale B2C or consumer internet platforms handling behavioural and event\-streaming data.
* Background in media, OTT, video, audio, music, social media, gaming, or news platforms.
* Exposure to Generative AI, embeddings, vector databases, or LLM\-based applications.



  





**What We Offer** 



* End\-to\-end ownership of data and AI platform infrastructure for a consumer product reaching tens of millions of users.
* Opportunity to work at the convergence of broadcast media and digital innovation on a greenfield super\-app build.
* Collaborative environment with AI/ML, product, and engineering teams working on high\-impact personalisation and content intelligence problems.
