title: Data Architect
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 The Data Architect \& Data Manager is responsible for defining and governing the end\-to\-end data architecture, data management practices, and business intelligence roadmap for the Logistics Data Domain. This role serves as the bridge between business stakeholders, data engineering teams, analytics professionals, and senior leadership, ensuring that data solutions align with strategic business objectives while adhering to enterprise data governance standards.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Design, maintain, and evolve scalable data architectures and data pipelines in Snowflake, applying proven relational database design principles and modern cloud data platform best practices.
* Define standards for data modeling, integration, transformation, storage, and consumption across logistics data products.
* Review and approve architectural designs, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture and data governance standards.
* Guide and mentor Data Engineers in implementing architecture solutions, ensuring compliance with coding standards, performance optimization practices, and data quality requirements.
* Monitor implementation progress and provide technical leadership throughout the development lifecycle.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, Data Analysts, and Visualization Engineers to gather and refine reporting and analytics requirements.
* Evaluate business intelligence requests based on strategic value, business impact, effort, and data readiness.
* Establish and maintain a prioritized analytics backlog and delivery roadmap.
* Resolve conflicts between tactical reporting demands and strategic data initiatives by ensuring alignment with long\-term business objectives.
* Promote reusable data products and self\-service analytics capabilities across the logistics organization.
* Ensure compliance with Data Governance standards, processes, policies, and controls.
* Define and monitor data quality improvement initiatives and remediation plans.
* Establish governance processes to ensure data remains fit for purpose, trusted, and available to support business operations and decision\-making.
* Oversee end\-to\-end data lifecycle management activities from creation through archival and retirement.
* Act as the primary point of contact for logistics\-related data topics.
* Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for logistics processes, transportation data, and supply chain analytics.
* Translate complex technical concepts, data architecture decisions, and analytics outcomes into business\-friendly language for senior management and business stakeholders.
* Facilitate consensus among business and technical teams regarding data priorities, definitions, and governance decisions.
* Act as mediator and decision facilitator when disagreements arise related to data ownership, definitions, quality, architecture, or reporting requirements.
* Provide coaching, mentoring, and performance feedback to Data Engineers, Data Analysts, and Visualization Engineers.
* Foster collaboration and accountability within multidisciplinary data teams.
* Promote adoption of best practices in data engineering, analytics, and governance.
* Develop and execute initiatives to improve data literacy across the Logistics organization.
* Enable stakeholders to make informed, data\-driven decisions through education, communication, and change management activities.
* Monitor and coordinate data\-related project activities across the Logistics Data Domain.
* Track project deliverables, milestones, risks, dependencies, and budgets.
* Support business case development and investment prioritization for data initiatives.
* Ensure data projects deliver measurable business value aligned with organizational priorities.
* Act as a trusted advisor for technology and data initiatives.
* Recommend appropriate data roles and skill profiles for projects, including Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Data Analysts, Visualization Engineers, Data Stewards, and Data Architects.
* Assess solution options and recommend fit\-for\-purpose technologies, architectures, and operating models.
* Support strategic planning and digital transformation initiatives through data expertise and thought leadership.


**What You Bring**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Management, Data Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or related field.
* 8\+ years of experience in Data Management, Data Architecture, Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, or Analytics.
* Proven experience designing enterprise\-scale data platforms and data pipelines.
* Experience managing multidisciplinary data teams and stakeholder landscapes.
* Experience implementing Data Governance and Data Quality frameworks.
* Proficiency in modern data platform technologies, including Snowflake, data modeling (conceptual, logical, and physical), SQL and relational database design, and ETL/ELT architecture to support scalable data solutions, efficient data integration, and reliable business insights.
* Proficiency in data warehousing, cloud data architectures, metadata and master data management, data quality management, and business intelligence tools such as Power BI, as well as experience with Agile methodologies and product backlog management to support robust data governance, scalable analytics solutions, and data‑driven decision‑making.
* Strong leadership and communication capabilities, including stakeholder management, influencing and negotiation skills, conflict resolution, coaching and mentoring, and the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to executive audiences while balancing strategic thinking with operational execution.


**About The Team**
 Our Global Functions play a key role in advancing the company's central initiatives and maintaining operational excellence across different groups, business areas, and regions. These roles support our vision to become the most valued energy technology company in the world. As part of our team, you supply to our vision by shaping the global energy transition, partnering with our internal and external collaborators, and conducting business responsibly and in compliance with legal requirements and regulations.

title: Software Development Engineer III
description:
**What is Hunch?**
 Hunch is a dating app built for follow\-through \- designed to turn mutual interest into a real first date instead of another chat thread that fizzles out. Built for people tired of mindless swiping and commodified matchmaking, Hunch uses an AI matchmaker to cut the week of back\-and\-forth and get two interested people out of the app and into the same room.
   

  

 With 2\.4M\+ daters, 1\.47M\+ dates planned, and 100% photo\-verified profiles, Hunch is growing fast in the US by challenging the swipe\-left/right norm of traditional apps. Hunch is a Series A funded ($23 Million) startup building the future of social discovery in a post\-AI world.
   

  

 Link to our fundraising announcement
   

  

**Key Offerings Of Hunch**
* One Drop a Day: A small, hand\-picked set of photo\-verified profiles arrives daily \- chosen for taste, lifestyle, and who's actually free to meet. So every profile gets real attention instead of a mindless swipe.
* Interest Becomes a Plan: When both people want to meet, Hunch's AI matchmaker turns mutual interest into a confirmed date with a real time and place \- no logistics to manage.
* Every Match, Verified: Every profile is matched to a live photo before it appears in anyone's drop. No bots, no catfishing \- just real, trustworthy connections.
* Built to Move: Chats close after seven days and users hold a few conversations at a time \- nudges designed to get people out the door, not scrolling forever.


**About The Role**
 We're on the lookout for a SDE\-III to join our lean, dynamic team as we scale. We believe in pushing boundaries, challenging the status quo, and embracing diversity of thought. You'll be building fast, smart, and with purpose — and we're looking for someone who can lead that charge both technically and culturally.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own backend features end\-to\-end — product problem to API, schema, migration, tests, and deployment. You solve the problem, not just the ticket.
* Build and run services across both stacks: TypeScript (Bun/Node, Prisma, Next.js) and Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy).
* Own async \& event\-driven work — queues, streaming ingestion, scheduled jobs, retries, and idempotency. (A lot of our load never touches a request handler.)
* Ship LLM\-backed product features — tool calling, structured outputs, grounding against real data, and the failure handling that keeps them sane in front of users.
* Keep production legible — tracing, metrics, and alerts that fire only when action is needed. You own your deploys and their consequences.


**What You'll Bring**
* 5\+ years building and running backend systems in production. You've been on the hook when things broke.
* Dual\-stack proficiency: TypeScript/Node \+ Python — strong in one, genuinely productive in the other. This isn't a "Python nice\-to\-have" role.
* Relational databases at depth: Postgres or MySQL — schema design, migrations, indexing, and reading query plans to fix the slow ones.
* Streaming/event infrastructure in production: Kinesis or Kafka — producers, consumers, partitioning, replay, and handling backpressure and duplicates.
* Service design \& delivery — clean contracts, sensible boundaries, and knowing when not to split a service. Hands\-on with AWS, Docker, and CI/CD.
* End\-to\-end ownership — you've carried features from idea to production and lived with the results. Founding or product\-engineer experience is a huge plus.
* Engineering hygiene — writing tests with the change (not after), disciplined releases, and caring whether the metric actually moved.


**Preferred Experience**
* ML Platform: Serving models behind APIs, vector retrieval (pgvector/FAISS), feature pipelines, and model versioning/rollout. Keeping models alive in production counts double.
* LLM Application Engineering: Agent loops, tool calling, structured output, and evaluating output quality programmatically. Self\-hosted inference (vLLM, GPU serving, cost tuning) is a strong plus.
* Data at Scale: Redshift/BigQuery/Snowflake, and observability tools (OpenTelemetry, Datadog).
* Experimentation: A/B and shadow tests, guardrail metrics, and the discipline to read a flat result honestly.
* Domain Experience: Consumer social or dating products.


**What We Offer**
* Competitive pay along with an annual performance\-linked incentive (PLI).
* Employee benefits like Medical Insurance.
* Participation in Employee Phantom Grants Program (Stock Options).


**Life at Hunch**
 Hunch is a small team focused on shipping the parts of dating that usually stall \- getting two interested people into the same room.
   

  

**What We Hire For \- The ABCs**
 Most companies have a long list of values nobody remembers. We have three, and they show up in how we hire, what we ship, and how we talk about the work:
   

  

* Authenticity \- Real before polished. We build for real people on real first dates, and we hire the same way. No theater. If something's not working, say so; if it is, ship it.
* Boldness \- Dating got stuck because nobody wanted to break the pattern. We make the call on what to ship, what to cut, and what doesn't belong in the product, even when it's the harder choice.
* Curiosity \- The best people here ask a lot of small, useful questions — about users, about the data, about each other's work. We trust people who keep learning over people who already know.


**How We Work**
* Ownership, not theater \- You own outcomes, not status updates. Fewer meetings, fewer dashboards, more shipping.
* Flexibility that's real \- We care about the work, not the hours you sit at a desk. Take the afternoon, take the week \- show up for the stuff that matters.
* Move fast, don't burn out \- Hunch ships quickly because we cut the slow stuff, not because we work people into the ground. Velocity comes from focus, not from hours.
* Small team, big problems \- You'll work on things that matter to millions of people trying to actually meet someone. Every role moves the product.


**Backed by Global Investors**
 Hunch is backed by Hashed, AlphaWave, Brevan Howard and Polygon Studios.
   

  

**Experienced Leadership**
 Hunch is founded by a trio of industry veterans: Ish Goel (CEO), Nitika Goel (CPO), and Kartic Rakhra (CMO) \- serial entrepreneurs with their last exit from Nexus Mutual, a web3 consumer\-tech startup.

title: Clinical Business Intelligence Manager
description:
**Clinical Business Intelligence Manager (AI Training)**
**About The Role**
 What if your deep expertise in healthcare analytics could directly influence how AI understands and reasons about clinical data? We're looking for an experienced Clinical Business Intelligence Manager to lead analytics work that sits at the intersection of healthcare intelligence and cutting\-edge AI development.
   

  

 This is a fully remote, flexible contract role built for senior professionals who know how to turn complex clinical and operational data into decisions that matter. You'll bring your healthcare BI leadership experience to a team working on some of the most advanced AI projects in the industry.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Lead and mentor a business intelligence team in building dashboards, reports, and analytics that support clinical and operational decision\-making
* Design, maintain, and optimize BI infrastructure — including data models, SQL queries, and reporting pipelines — ensuring accuracy, reliability, and performance
* Analyze clinical, operational, and performance data to uncover meaningful trends and surface insights that support leadership decisions
* Translate complex healthcare datasets into clear, trusted outputs that drive improvements in care delivery and organizational efficiency
* Apply your domain expertise to evaluate, quality\-check, and improve AI\-generated outputs related to clinical analytics and healthcare data reasoning


**Who You Are**
* Experienced in healthcare or clinical analytics, business intelligence, or data management within regulated environments
* Proven track record designing and managing BI systems — including dashboards, reporting pipelines, and data models
* Comfortable working with clinical, operational, and administrative datasets and understanding their real\-world implications
* Strong communicator who can translate technical findings into meaningful narratives for both clinical and operational stakeholders
* Self\-directed and reliable — you deliver quality work independently without hand\-holding


**Nice to Have**
* Prior experience with data annotation, data quality assurance, or evaluation systems
* Familiarity with AI tools, LLM outputs, or AI training workflows
* Background in health informatics, population health, or value\-based care analytics
* Experience with tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar BI platforms


**Why Join Us**
* Work alongside world\-leading AI research labs on genuinely cutting\-edge projects
* Fully remote and flexible — structure your work around your life, not the other way around
* Freelance autonomy with the substance of meaningful, high\-impact work
* Gain direct exposure to advanced large language models and how they're trained and evaluated
* Contribute clinical intelligence expertise to AI systems that will shape how healthcare data is understood at scale
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

title: xECM for Success Factors Consultant
description:
**Department:** 
 Delivery
 



**Location:** 
 India Remote
   

  




**Description**
**Engagement Details:** 
* Employment type: Temporary contract
* Contract Duration: 6 months
* Work Schedule: Full\-Time, Start ASAP
* Work Location: India Remote


**Summary:**
 We are seeking a highly skilled and detail\-oriented specialist with deep expertise in OpenText Extended ECM and SAP SuccessFactors. This role involves designing, implementing, and optimizing integrated content management solutions to support HR business processes. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical knowledge, consulting experience, and a strategic mindset to align technology with HR operational needs.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and implement integrations between OpenText Extended ECM and SAP SuccessFactors, ensuring seamless data and content flow.
* Configure and customize Extended ECM solutions to support document management, records management, archiving, and HR workflows.
* Optimize SuccessFactors modules such as Employee Central, Recruiting, Onboarding, Performance \& Goals, and Learning by linking them with ECM content.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to map metadata and ensure consistency between HR data and content repositories.
* Ensure compliance with regulations such as GDPR, HIPAA, and EEOC through robust content retention and security strategies.
* Troubleshoot technical issues, develop tailored integration solutions, and deliver enhancements based on user feedback.
* Lead or support implementation projects using SAP Activate, Agile, or similar methodologies.
* Conduct workshops, gather business requirements, and provide training and support to HR and IT stakeholders.
* Communicate technical solutions effectively to non\-technical audiences, emphasizing HR and business impact.


**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
**Required Education:** 
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Human Resources Technology, or a related field.
* Equivalent experience may be considered in lieu of a degree


**Required Technical Skills:**
* **OpenText Extended ECM Expertise** 
	+ In\-depth knowledge of features such as document and records management, workflows, and content archiving.
	+ Experience with Content Server, Business Workspaces, and Archive Center.
	+ Ability to configure and customize ECM for HR use cases, especially in SuccessFactors environments.
* **SAP SuccessFactors Knowledge** 
	+ Proficiency with modules including Employee Central, Recruiting, Onboarding, Performance \& Goals, and Learning.
	+ Familiarity with SuccessFactors data model, APIs (OData, SFAPI), and HR objects.
	+ Understanding of UI elements like People Profile and document embedding.
* **Integration Skills** 
	+ Hands\-on experience integrating OpenText ECM with SuccessFactors via pre\-built connectors or custom APIs.
	+ Proficient with SAP Integration Suite, MuleSoft, or Dell Boomi for middleware integration.
	+ Skilled in metadata mapping between HR systems and content platforms.
* **Document and Records Management** 
	+ Management of HR\-related unstructured content (e.g., resumes, contracts, certifications).
	+ Familiarity with compliance frameworks and content lifecycle governance.
* **Programming and Scripting** 
	+ Working knowledge of JavaScript, Python, or Java for ECM customization and API interaction.
	+ Experience with OData query language and basic SQL for metadata and content queries.
* **Cloud and Deployment** 
	+ Understanding of cloud, hybrid, and on\-premises deployment models for OpenText Extended ECM.
	+ Familiarity with SAP BTP services, including SAP Cloud Integration and Document Management.


**Domain Knowledge:** 
* **HR Business Processes** 
	+ Deep understanding of recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and learning workflows.
	+ Insight into how integrated content supports and enhances these processes.
* **Business Process Optimization** 
	+ Ability to streamline HR operations by aligning structured data and unstructured content.
	+ Experience in automating approvals and reducing manual content handling.


**Soft Skills:** 
* Strong problem\-solving skills to address integration and configuration challenges.
* Excellent communication skills to work across HR, IT, and business teams.
* Experience managing projects, including scope, timeline, and stakeholder coordination.
* Client\-facing consulting experience, including requirements gathering, stakeholder engagement, and user training.


**Preferred Qualifications:** 
* Certifications in OpenText Extended ECM or SAP SuccessFactors (e.g., SAP Certified Associate – Employee Central).
* Familiarity with related tools such as SAP Document Management Service or OpenText Documentum.
* Experience in change management to support user adoption and organizational transformation.

title: Data and Application Integration Engineer
description:
**About Milliman**
 Independent for over 70 years, Milliman delivers market\-leading services and solutions to clients worldwide. Today, we are helping companies take on some of the world’s most critical and complex issues, including retirement funding and healthcare financing, risk management and regulatory compliance, data analytics and business transformation. Through a team of professionals ranging from actuaries to clinicians, technology specialists to plan administrators, we offer unparalleled expertise in employee benefits, investment consulting, healthcare, life insurance, and financial services, and property and casualty insurance.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Milliman is undertaking a major business transformation program to replace and modernize our HRIS, Finance, Legal, and Professional Services Automation systems. As part of the Data Enablement Team, we are seeking a Data \& Application Integration Engineer to support the integrity, quality, and migration of data throughout this transformation. This role will work alongside senior engineers and business/technical teams, contributing to data mapping, migration, validation, and integration activities to enable a smooth transition to new enterprise platforms. This is a great opportunity for someone early\-to\-mid in their integration engineering career to grow their skills on a large\-scale enterprise transformation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Support the design, development, and implementation of application integrations under the guidance of senior team members.
* Assist with A2A (application\-to\-application) integrations, including cloud\-to\-cloud, cloud\-to\-on\-premise, and on\-premise\-to\-on\-premise scenarios.
* Help migrate legacy integration processes into a centralized, standardized platform.
* Assist in gathering and documenting reference data sources, supporting strategies for managing reference and master data (MDM).
* Build data integration pipelines using modern data engineering tools and practices, with support from senior engineers.
* Develop and maintain data workflows, and help automate recurring processes.
* Build data processing solutions using Azure Data Factory (ADF), Boomi, Snaplogic, Workato, or similar tools.
* Follow established data governance, data privacy, and security standards.
* Support CI/CD pipelines for integration and deployment of data solutions.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of experience in application integration, data engineering, or systems engineering.
* Exposure to data/application integration tools such as Azure Data Factory, Boomi, Snaplogic, Workato, or similar.
* Working proficiency with SQL and Python, and experience with relational databases.
* Foundational experience with data analysis, data profiling, data mapping, and ETL processes.
* Basic familiarity with CI/CD practices and tools.
* Good analytical skills with the ability to help translate business requirements into technical specifications.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills, with willingness to collaborate across business and technical teams.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast\-paced project environment, with a comfort level asking questions, seeking guidance, and learning quickly as part of a larger transformation team.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Exposure to Azure Fabric or other cloud data platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
* Some exposure to HRIS, Finance, Legal, or Professional Services Automation systems.
* Familiarity with data governance or master data management (MDM) concepts.
* Interest in or coursework related to insurance, risk management, or financial services.
* Awareness of regulatory requirements related to data privacy and security.

A Forward Deployed Infrastructure Transformation Engineer is a production engineer who works embedded inside a client's enterprise, shoulder to shoulder with their teams, to transform legacy infrastructure \& Application estates into AI\-ready, cloud/Hybrid platforms and Modernized Infrastructure. You own outcomes: time\-to\-value, reliability, adoption, and scalability. Not delivery milestones. Outcomes.
   

  

 The Role expects the expertise to build cloud including Data and AI foundations that is secure \& scalable and responsive — designing AI Infrastructure architectures including Compute, Data, Networking and security aspects leveraging Hybrid cloud models.
   

  

 Accenture's Forward Deployed Infrastructure Transformation Engineers operate at the intersection of engineering depth and business reinvention. This is where the most complex enterprise infrastructure challenges get solved — not in a lab, but inside real client environments, with real constraints, at real scale.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

* Embed directly with client infrastructure and engineering teams to design, execute, and operationalize end\-to\-end transformation — spanning cloud foundation, hyperconverged infrastructure, platform engineering, application modernization, database transformation, SAP, network and security, and AI platform deployment — inside real enterprise environments
* Accountable for production outcomes — platform reliability, time\-to\-value, adoption, and scalability — measured against business metrics, not project milestones.
* Move from ambiguous infrastructure problems to working production environment through rapid iteration: days to validated architecture, weeks to production\-ready deployment.
* Execute application migration hands\-on — rehost (lift \& shift), re\-platform (lift \& optimize), and redeploy — applying the right strategy per workload to land on an AI\-ready, modernized target platform.
* Architect and implement network and security foundations: Zero Trust, SASE/SSE, micro\-segmentation, container security, and application AI governance across enterprise environments.
* Design and govern transformation architectures across the full enterprise stack: compute (HCI/cloud), platform engineering and Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs), Kubernetes orchestration, CI/CD pipelines, network, security, storage, containers, databases, applications, and AI platform layers.
* Build the Data and AI foundation layer: design data architectures for structured and unstructured data deploy the AI platform layer that enables modernized workloads to leverage AI at scale.
* Architect and modernize database estates — relational and NoSQL database migration, schema conversion, performance tuning, and cloud\-native database deployment — as the data layer underpinning the modernized platform.
* Leverage Python end\-to\-end — infrastructure automation, deployment scripting, data pipeline engineering, and AI agent development across the full transformation lifecycle.
* Translate technical architecture into business impact for client CTO, CFO, and CISO shape modernization roadmaps, ROI backlogs, and AI adoption strategy.
* Build reusable patterns, playbooks, and accelerators through architecture workshops, proofs of concept, and code\-with sessions — leaving the client team fully capable of operating, scaling, and extending the platform independently, and codifying learnings that grow the FDE practice


 Professional \& Technical Skills:
   

  

* Engineering Mindset should come in the beginning.
* Minimum 2 years of working experience of AI platform ecosystems — cloud\-native AI services (AWS, Azure, GCP), open\-source model deployment, and the infrastructure layer required to run AI workloads reliably at enterprise scale.
* 3 to 5 years of engineering experience with cloud\-native systems. \& have the ability to deploy and guiding team to deploy AI use cases
* Minimum 1 years of experience designing, deploying and operating AI platforms and infrastructure — model serving environments, AI\-ready compute, data pipelines, and platform integration — in production enterprise environments
* 10\+ years of infrastructure engineering experience, with demonstrable production delivery across cloud platforms, network, Security, Kubernetes, containerization, platform engineering, and enterprise application environments.
* Track record of owning and delivering infrastructure transformation outcomes inside live enterprise environments — not advisory engagements, internal initiatives, vendor labs, or contained team deployments.
* Ability to connect infrastructure decisions to business/financial outcomes — translating platform reliability, migration efficiency, and modernization gains into business impact a CFO would fund and act on.
* Experience presenting to and building trust with senior client stakeholders at CTO, CFO, or CISO level.
* Non\-linear profiles are expected and welcomed — assessment is based on demonstrated delivery experience and outcome ownership, not CV pattern matching.


 Additional Information:
   

  

* Strong problem\-solving skills
* Flexible to work in 24\*7 environment

 AXA XL’s Reward program is designed to take care of what matters most to you, covering the full picture of your health, wellbeing, lifestyle and financial security. It provides competitive compensation and personalized, inclusive benefits that evolve as you do.
   

  

 We’re committed to rewarding your contribution for the long term, so you can be your best self today and look forward to the future with confidence.
   

  

**Sustainability**
 At AXA XL, Sustainability is integral to our business strategy. In an ever\-changing world, AXA XL protects what matters most for our clients and communities. We know that sustainability is at the root of a more resilient future. Our 2023\-26 Sustainability strategy, called “Roots of resilience”, focuses on protecting natural ecosystems, addressing climate change, and embedding sustainable practices across our operations.
   

  

**Our Pillars**
* Valuing nature: How we impact nature affects how nature impacts us. Resilient ecosystems \- the foundation of a sustainable planet and society – are essential to our future. We’re committed to protecting and restoring nature – from mangrove forests to the bees in our backyard – by increasing biodiversity awareness and inspiring clients and colleagues to put nature at the heart of their plans.
* Addressing climate change: The effects of a changing climate are far\-reaching and significant. Unpredictable weather, increasing temperatures, and rising sea levels cause both social inequalities and environmental disruption. We're building a net zero strategy, developing insurance products and services, and mobilizing to advance thought leadership and investment in societal\-led solutions.
* Integrating ESG: All companies have a role to play in building a more resilient future. Incorporating ESG considerations into our internal processes and practices builds resilience from the roots of our business. We’re training our colleagues, engaging our external partners, and evolving our sustainability governance and reporting.
* AXA Hearts in Action: We have established volunteering and charitable giving programs to help colleagues support causes that matter most to them, known as AXA XL’s “Hearts in Action” programs. These include our Matching Gifts program, Volunteering Leave, and our annual volunteering day – the Global Day of Giving.


 For more information, please see axaxl.com/sustainability.

title: Specialist, Oracle HCM
description:
**Make your mark with Thiess**
 Every day, all around the world, Thiess supports and celebrates our people. We recognise talent, reward transparency, champion diversity and embrace change.
   

  

 Join us and hone your skills and develop new ones. Take on big challenges and grow through mentorship, collaboration, and empowerment.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 As Oracle HCM Application Specialist within the People Systems team, you will support and enhance Thiess's HR systems and technology landscape, applying strong technical and functional expertise in Oracle HCM Cloud configuration, integrations, and data management to deliver reliable system solutions and process efficiencies that improve the employee and leader experience across the business globally.
   

  

**Reporting to the Manager, People Systems, you will provide timely, high\-quality technical support to the HR team and broader business, including the scoping, implementation, and optimisation of HR systems projects to ensure accurate, consistent, and efficient outcomes.**
**As the Specialist, Oracle HCM, you will:**
**Operational BAU Support**
* Act as the first and second point of contact for Oracle HCM issues raised by the global workforce through the ticketing system.
* Be the HR domain expert and HCM functional specialist for the implemented modules including Core HR, Talent, Performance, Goals,


**Recruitment, Onboarding And Compensation \& Benefits.**
* Support strategy and roadmap formulation for Oracle HCM and other HR systems, supporting the Manager, People Systems.
* Triage, investigate, and resolve incidents and service requests within agreed service levels.
* Provide ongoing L2/L3 functional and technical support for production issues, service requests, and change requests, ensuring SLA\-driven system stability.
* Make system configuration changes, correct data, and troubleshoot issues across HCM modules.
* Keep clear records of resolutions, configurations, and known issues.
* Escalate complex issues to Oracle Support or implementation partners (CIMIC / Oracle / WIPRO) where needed.


**Projects**
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of HCM rollout projects, from requirements and solution design through configuration, data migration, cutover, and hypercare support.
* Support the rollout of Oracle HCM across different geographies, and Thiess businesses working with regional HR, Payroll, and IT stakeholders.
* Define integration requirements between Oracle HCM and other systems, and resolve integration issues.
* Take part in fit\-gap analysis and recommend target\-state design and process improvements.
* Present project updates, steering committee papers, and post\-implementation reviews to leadership.


**Enhancements**
* Identify opportunities to improve systems and processes based on user feedback and recurring trends.
* Support the design, testing, and roll\-out of new features, functionality, and quarterly Oracle updates.
* Drive continuous HCM optimisation and automation of operational tasks and reporting.
* Build and maintain reports and dashboards using BI Publisher and OTBI for actionable HR insights.
* Support change impact assessment and user communication or training for new enhancements.


 Commercial \& Stakeholder Relationships
   

  

* Look for cost efficiencies where possible, without compromising safety.
* Engage others by focusing on common ground and shared objectives.
* Consult with stakeholders before making decisions.


**People \& Leadership**
* Work towards plans to achieve team and business goals.
* Support others to deliver results and improvements.
* Coordinate effectively across teams and manage issues, conflict, and problems as they arise.
* Build collaborative relationships with global HR functions.


 Health, Safety \& Sustainability
   

  

* Understand the critical risks in your area and reassess hazards if the work area changes.
* Know and apply the standards and procedures relevant to your role. Stop the job if in doubt, fix the problem, or warn others of danger.


**About You**
**Formal Education**
* Bachelor's and/ or master's degree in technology, Human Resources, or a related field preferred.
* Oracle HCM Cloud certification(s) advantageous.


**Work Experience**
* 3\+ years' experience working with Oracle HCM / Fusion.
* In\-depth experience with Oracle HCM modules including Core HR, Talent, Performance, Goals, Recruitment, Onboarding and Compensation \& Benefits.
* Experience supporting or delivering Oracle HCM Cloud implementation projects, ideally across multiple countries spread across diverse businesses.


**Technical Skills**
* Strong domain knowledge of HR, Payroll, Time \& Attendance and Talent management processes is a must
* Strong technical and functional knowledge of Oracle HCM Cloud, including configuration, integrations, and data management.
* Confident troubleshooting skills, able to diagnose and resolve issues efficiently within a ticketing environment.
* Understanding of system integrations (e.g., middleware, third\-party HR platforms) and data governance principles.
* Able to translate business requirements into practical, scalable system solutions.
* Proficient in MS PowerPoint, Word and Excel.
* Well\-developed written and oral communication, with excellent attention to detail.
* Comfortable working with stakeholders across Mining Operations, HR, Payroll, IT, Finance and business leadership in different regions and time zones.
* Strong understanding of HR processes and associated workflows.


**What's On Offer**
 At Thiess, our people are the heart of everything we do. We're committed to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive \- safely, confidently and with opportunities to grow.
   

  

* Competitive salary package.
* Ongoing training \& development opportunities.
* A strong safety\-first culture across all operations, built on care, respect and accountability.
* Range of corporate discounts including health insurance (Medibank), travel \& retail products.


**About Thiess**
 Thiess works with clients in Australia, Asia and the Americas in the dynamic field of open\-cut and underground mining.
   

  

 The pioneering spirit of our founders – the legendary Thiess brothers – is our legacy and inspires our vision to harness the power of people and technology to drive sustainable change.
   

  

 At Thiess, you will have the opportunity to play a part in the global energy transition. We are growing our commodities portfolio to include metals and minerals critical to the energy transition and developing services to enable sustainable mining.
   

  

 We’re creating a culture of curiosity, knowledge\-sharing, and continuous learning – supporting our people to contribute to Thiess’ success and continued growth in sustainable mining.
   

  

 We’ll support you in honing your skills and developing new ones, taking on challenges and growing through mentorship, collaboration, and empowerment. We offer our people ongoing technical training and development opportunities so they can reach their full potential. We also invest in the workforce of the future, with a range of programs for people starting their careers.
   

  

 We recognise the value of an inclusive and diverse workplace through our vision of everyone matters always. We’re focused on creating an inclusive environment to enable our people to bring their best self to work because they feel safe, included and empowered.
   

  

**About Capability Hubs**
 Thiess’ Capability Hubs are a key part of how we deliver work globally \- connecting skilled talent with business needs to provide high\-quality, efficient, and scalable services across functions and regions. The Capability Hubs enable access to global capability, supporting business growth while strengthening consistency, performance, and value delivery across Thiess.
   

  

 Our Capability Hubs operate as an integrated extension of the business, working in close partnership with Service Recipients to deliver outcomes that matter. With a strong focus on service discipline, governance, and continuous improvement, the Hubs play a critical role in how Thiess operates and evolves.
   

  

**Make your mark \- Globally, People First**
 Our Capability Hubs offer the opportunity to make your mark as part of a global business, collaborating across diverse teams to connect global capability with local delivery.
   

  

 You will contribute to shared success while building valuable professional experience in a supportive and respectful environment where your contribution is rewarded, and your wellbeing is valued.
   

  

 This experience is underpinned by four key pillars \- Global Connection, Meaningful Contribution, Career Opportunities, and a Values\-led Culture \- which define what it means to work within our Capability Hubs.
   

  

 You will work globally with diverse teams, broadening your perspective and deepening your expertise, while contributing to meaningful outcomes that deliver value to the business.
   

  

 You will also build practical experience and capability to support your ongoing career growth, within a values\-led culture where people are respected, supported, and recognised for their contribution.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 This role is an opportunity to take the next step in your career. With our culture of recognition, development, and a stimulating and satisfying work environment, there is no better time to join Thiess.
   

  

 Please click the "
 **apply** 
 " button below to apply for this role.
   

  

 Thiess follows an Employment check Process for all successful applicants, which includes two employment references, an ID check, educational and a medical assessment. These checks are essential to your application, and your recruiter will support you through the process.
   

  

 Should you require assistance applying for this opportunity, please contact us at RecruitmentIndia@thiess.com

title: Specialist, Investment Data Management
description:
We are looking for a
 **Specialist, Investment Data Management** 
 to join our Investment Data \& Analytics team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a dynamic strategic team whose scope and importance continue to grow. The IDA Department, within CCLFG’s Investment Operations Group, supports industry standards and customized analytics in addition to data. We support pre\-trade analysis, modeling, trading, compliance, as well as post\-trade performance, attribution, client reporting, sales reporting, and custom analytics. The Investment Data Management (IDM) Team, part of the Investment Data and Analytics (IDA) group resides within the middle office and is responsible for managing data centric processes and data quality that supports the investment management business. The team ensures that daily and historical data is accurate, data delivery processes are successful, and comply with overall data governance. IDM is a key thought\-leader in driving data management maturity at Connor, Clark \& Lunn Financial Group (CCLFG). CCLFG manages a wide range of global assets and heavily relies on the output of the IDM for a variety of functions from the front office to back office. We place a high value on maintaining an entrepreneurial spirit and creating a culture where each of us has opportunities to succeed. We are a solution orientated and collaborative team seeking like\-minded individuals who thrive in a challenging and dynamic environment.
   

  

**Work Timings** 
 : AM Shift (6:30 AM – 3:30 PM) or PM Shift (1:30 PM – 10:30 PM)
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Work at the intersection of business operations and systems technology to create, manage, and maintain high‑quality investment data across a wide range of global security types.
* Own and oversee data processes, proactively investigating and resolving data issues while supporting continuous process improvement and ad‑hoc problem solving
* Act as a process owner collaborating with global investment managers, traders, portfolio managers, compliance, technology, and middle‑/back‑office teams
* Leverage strong analytical skills and attention to detail to work with databases and business applications, write business requirements, and support testing and implementation of system enhancement
* Maintain and validate fixed\-income, equity and derivatives reference and pricing data across multiple systems and databases with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail
* Prioritize, monitor, and manage scheduled processes, ad\-hoc requests, and projects in collaboration with multiple business partners to support analytic, investing, and portfolio management functions
* Provide key pre\-modeling data signoffs for investment affiliates
* Analyze exception reports and follow\-up to ensure timely resolution
* Identify, develop, and implement scalable improvements to support ever\-changing requirements
* Support process improvements to increase efficiency, mitigate risk, and increase the level of service provided to stakeholders
* Support continuous data quality improvements (policy, procedures, processes, audits)

**What You Bring**

* Industry Knowledge – 1\-3 years of experience in the investment management industry with exposure to securities data, data quality and process management. Hands\-on experience working with Bloomberg, FTSE, ICE Bond Edge, Charles River and related financial tools, platforms is an asset.
* Problem Solver – You possess an analytical mindset and able to break down complex processes into components to logically deduce the root cause of issues
* Collaborative – You have a collaborative spirit that helps you to work well with others and you communicate effectively
* Self\-Motivated – You have a passion for advancing the quality, scale, and efficiency of data processes and can take ownership of multiple processes with keen attention to detail

title: Salesforce CPQ engineer 3
description:
Engineer 3, Business Systems (CPQ)
   

  

 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
   

  

**About Team**
 The CRM Technologies Team plays a critical role in optimizing our sales processes, streamlining customer interactions, and maximizing the efficiency of our sales efforts. By leveraging Salesforce and Quote\-to\-Cash technologies, the team ensures that business users have the tools, automation, and operational support needed to effectively manage quoting, pricing, approvals, and downstream business processes.
   

  

 With deep expertise in Salesforce development, CPQ, integrations, and platform operations, the team continuously enhances the CRM ecosystem to meet evolving business needs. The team partners closely with stakeholders across Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, Deal Desk, and Engineering to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable Quote\-to\-Cash solutions.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a CPQ Engineer III to design, build, and support core capabilities in our Configure–Price–Quote (CPQ) stack that power how our GTM teams sell and price MongoDB offerings. As a senior individual contributor, you will own end\-to\-end delivery of features across configuration, pricing, discounting, approvals, and quote generation, working closely with Product, Deal Strategy, RevOps, and Sales.
   

  

 You will translate business requirements into high\-quality technical solutions on Salesforce CPQ and related platforms, spanning configuration, custom development (Apex/LWC/Flows), and integrations with downstream systems. This role is hands\-on and delivery\-focused: you will be responsible for implementing well\-structured, testable solutions, improving performance and reliability of existing CPQ flows, and contributing to shared patterns, frameworks, and best practices within the CPQ \& RevOps engineering team.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

* Design, build, and support Salesforce solutions across product modeling, pricing, quoting, approvals, amendments, and renewals
* Configure and enhance CPQ capabilities including product rules, price rules, bundles, product options, quote templates, discounting, and approval workflows
* Partner with Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Deal Desk to understand requirements, identify process gaps, and deliver scalable business solutions
* Develop and maintain Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, SOQL, and platform APIs to support related processes
* Build and support integrations between Salesforce and external systems such as ERP, billing, payment, contract, and other enterprise platforms
* Participate in technical design, story grooming, sprint planning, testing, code reviews, release management, and production deployments
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues across CPQ configuration, pricing logic, automation, integrations, and system performance
* Support documentation, UAT, regression testing, and user enablement to improve adoption and platform reliability
* Ensure solutions align with security, data governance, and Salesforce platform best practices
* Leverage AI\-powered engineering tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Agentforce, GitHub Copilot, and similar capabilities to improve productivity, analysis, troubleshooting, and documentation, while using sound judgment around security, accuracy, and responsible AI usage


**Responsibilities**
* Technical Delivery: Translate complex business strategies into scalable technical solutions on Salesforce CPQ, utilizing a mix of declarative configuration and custom development (Apex, LWC, and Flow)
* System Architecture: Design and implement robust integrations between CPQ and downstream systems (ERP, Billing, Telemetry) to ensure data integrity across the Lead\-to\-Cash lifecycle
* Engineering Excellence: Drive high standards for code quality by implementing testable, modular solutions and contributing to shared frameworks and CI/CD best practices
* Performance Optimization: Proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks in existing CPQ flows, improving calculator speed and user experience for a global sales force
* Mentorship \& Influence: Lead peer code reviews and contribute to the team’s technical playbook, fostering a culture of continuous improvement within the CPQ \& RevOps engineering organization


**Minimum Requirements**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* 6\+ years of Salesforce development experience, including strong hands\-on expertise in the Salesforce platform
* Good understanding of Quote\-to\-Cash processes, sales workflows, and Salesforce best practices
* Hands\-on experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, SOQL, and REST/SOAP APIs
* Experience with product modeling, pricing rules, quoting workflows, approvals, amendments, and renewals
* Experience integrating Salesforce with external systems such as ERP, billing, payment, or other enterprise platforms
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum, CI/CD, version control, and Salesforce release practices
* Strong understanding of Salesforce security, data governance, and implementation best practices
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills
* Salesforce CPQ Specialist and Salesforce Platform Developer I or II certifications required


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Working knowledge of Salesforce Billing and its underlying data model
* Experience with Salesforce DX, Copado, Gearset, Git\-based workflows, or similar DevOps tooling
* Familiarity with Visualforce, HTML, JavaScript, and CSS
* Experience preparing training materials, supporting UAT/regression testing, and guiding business users through solution adoption
* Practical familiarity with AI\-powered and agentic tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Agentforce, and similar platforms, with the ability to use them thoughtfully to improve delivery speed, analysis, documentation quality, and engineering effectiveness


 Success Measures
   

  

* In 3 months, you will: Develop a strong understanding of MongoDB’s CPQ implementation, product and pricing structure, Quote\-to\-Cash flows, and stakeholder processes.
* In 6 months, you will: Successfully deliver meaningful enhancements across Salesforce CPQ, support key pricing and quoting workflows, and become a dependable contributor to ongoing QTC initiatives.
* In 12 months, you will: Become a trusted technical SME for Salesforce CPQ and related Quote\-to\-Cash processes, helping drive scalable improvements across pricing, approvals, renewals, amendments, and downstream integrations.


**About MongoDB**
 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud\-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi\-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
   

  

 With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI\-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
   

  

 Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
   

  

 To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
   

  

 MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
   

  

 MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

title: Senior Engineer, Cloud Infrastructure
description:
**Overview**
 Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,500\+ employees and \~30,000 customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500\. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.
   

  

 Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.
   

  

**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**
 Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI\-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation
   

  

 Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI\-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.
   

  

***Recruitment Scam Notice:***
*Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will come from accounts formatted as “* 
*name@cvent.com* 
*” email address. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.*
*If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at recruitingindia@cvent.com.*
*For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice.* 
*https://www.cvent.com/en/notice\-recruitment\-fraud* 
*.*
 As a member of
 **Cloud Infrastructure team** 
 , you will design, build, and operate the AWS foundation that underpins Cvent’s products. You will own complex infrastructure services end\-to\-end, drive automation\-first practices, and help evolve our “paved road” for engineers building on AWS.
   

  

 A key focus for this role is to
 **apply AI/ML and AI agents to Cloud Infrastructure operations** 
 – using single and multi‑agent systems and orchestration frameworks to automate diagnostics, runbooks, and workflows while maintaining strong guardrails around security, reliability, and cost.
   

  

 You will collaborate closely with Cloud Infrastructure peers, SREs, Security Engineering, and product teams across geographies.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
**Cloud Infrastructure Engineering (AWS)**
* Design, implement, and operate highly available, secure, and scalable AWS infrastructure (e.g., VPC, Transit Gateway, EC2, Load Balancing, S3, EBS/EFS/FSx, Route 53, IAM, KMS, Backup).
* Build and maintain infrastructure\-as\-code using tools such as AWS CDK / CloudFormation, enforcing standards, guardrails, and reusable patterns.
* Develop automation and tooling (primarily in Python/TypeScript) to remove repetitive operational work (provisioning, patching, configuration, cleanup, compliance checks, reporting).
* Contribute to and sometimes lead design reviews, architecture discussions, and RFCs for new or evolving infrastructure services.
* Partner with Security and Compliance to meet security, audit, and regulatory requirements across accounts and regions.


**AI Agents, Orchestration \& Multi‑Agent Systems**
* Identify high‑value Cloud Infra workflows (e.g., incident triage, change impact analysis, runbook execution, capacity/cost recommendations) that can be automated using AI agents.
* Design and implement agentic workflows (single and multi‑agent) using modern AI orchestration patterns and frameworks (e.g., tool‑calling, planners, evaluators, guardrails).
* Integrate agents with existing cloud APIs, observability tools, ticketing systems, and runbooks to provide end‑to‑end, human\-in\-the\-loop automation.
* Define and enforce safety, security, and approval guardrails for AI‑driven actions (RBAC, policy checks, dry‑runs, explicit approvals, audit logging).
* Measure and communicate impact of AI automation (MTTR reduction, hours saved, error reduction, cost optimization, improved engineer experience).


**Reliability, Operations \& On‑Call**
* Own the reliability and performance of services you build – from design through deployment and production operations.
* Implement and tune monitoring, logging, alerting, and SLO/SLA dashboards for Cloud Infra services (Datadog/Splunk/CloudWatch or similar).
* Participate in the on‑call rotation, lead troubleshooting for complex AWS infrastructure incidents, and drive post‑incident reviews and preventative improvements.
* Proactively identify technical debt and reliability risks in infrastructure and drive remediation plans.


**Collaboration, Mentoring \& Best Practices**
* Act as a technical mentor to Engineer I/II teammates on AWS fundamentals, automation patterns, and AI‑driven operations.
* Help define and evolve paved road standards for AWS infrastructure, automation, and AI agent usage across Cloud Infrastructure.
* Contribute to runbooks, design docs, knowledge base articles, and internal training sessions, including AI and automation best practices


**Required Qualifications**
**Here's What You Need:**
* 3–6 years of hands\-on‑ experience in Cloud / Infrastructure Engineering, or similar roles, with strong focus on AWS.
* Deep understanding of core AWS services: VPC \& networking (subnets, routing, TGW, VPN/Direct Connect, security groups, NACLs), EC2, Auto Scaling, Load Balancing, S3, EBS/EFS/FSx, Route 53, IAM, KMS, CloudWatch/CloudTrail, and Backup.
* Strong experience with Infrastructure\-as\-Code (AWS CDK, CloudFormation, or Terraform) and Git\-based workflows (branching, PR reviews, CI/CD).
* Solid programming skills in at least one language commonly used for infra\-automation, such as Python or TypeScript/Node.js.
* Proven track record designing and operating production\-grade, multi‑account/multi‑region AWS environments with a focus on security, reliability, and cost.
* Experience implementing observability for infrastructure services (metrics, logs, traces, alerting, dashboards).
* Demonstrated ability to own complex projects end\-to\-end: requirements, design, implementation, rollout, and post‑launch improvements.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills; comfortable working with distributed teams and multiple stakeholders (SRE, Security, product engineering, leadership).


**AI / Agentic Skills – Required**
* Practical experience building or integrating LLM\-based solutions (e.g., using OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure/OpenAI\-compatible, or similar APIs).
* Hands\-on experience with at least one of:
+ AI agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph\-style, CrewAI\-like, or custom agent patterns), or
+ Orchestrating multi\-step AI workflows using tools, function calling, or custom planners.

* Ability to translate infra problems into agentic workflows (e.g., “given alerts \+ context, generate and execute an actionable runbook; escalate with a summarized context if confidence is low”).
* Familiarity with prompt engineering, retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG), and techniques to constrain and evaluate AI outputs in production.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience in a large\-scale SaaS or multi‑tenant environment.
* Exposure to cost optimization / FinOps in AWS (right‑sizing, storage optimization, data transfer analysis, automated cleanup).
* Experience with security engineering concepts such as least‑privilege IAM design, KMS usage patterns, and network security controls.
* Experience integrating AI agents with ticketing and workflow platforms (Jira/ServiceNow, Slack/MS Teams bots, internal tools).
* AWS certifications (e.g., Solutions Architect – Associate/Professional, Security – Specialty, or Advanced Networking) or equivalent experience.


**Success in This Role**
**In Your First 12–18 Months, Success Looks Like**
* You are a go‑to engineer for complex AWS infrastructure questions in your domain.
* You have delivered at least one or two production AI‑agent workflows that measurably improve Cloud Infra operations (e.g., reduced MTTR, reduced manual toil, or better cost visibility).
* Your infrastructure services are well‑documented, observable, and resilient, with clear runbooks and strong hand‑offs to on‑call engineers.
* You are actively mentoring Engineer I/II teammates and influencing our standards for AWS, automation, and responsible AI usage.

* Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills with the ability to work effectively in global, cross\-functional teams.
* A continuous learning mindset and passion for cloud technologies, automation, and operational excellence.


**About The Team**
 The COMOS PLM team supports a global Azure\-based platform used by hundreds of users across Siemens Energy. The team works closely with business stakeholders, platform experts, and Microsoft Azure specialists to deliver secure, reliable, and high\-performing cloud services.
   

  

 The environment promotes innovation, collaboration, automation, and continuous improvement, enabling the team to provide scalable digital solutions that support Siemens Energy’s global operations.

 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities.  5–7 years of direct and relevant experience with end\-to\-end ownership of IT infrastructure, security, and operations
   

  

**Industry Preference:** 
 EdTech, Education SaaS, Social Impact / Development Sector, or purpose\-led B2B/B2G organisations
   

  

* About iDream Education


**Vision:** 
 Unlimited Learning. Unlimited Growth. For Everyone.
   

  

**Belief:** 
 We believe that access to learning and growth is a fundamental right, and that learning in its truest sense is the joyful unfolding of a being's fullest potential — in all dimensions of life.
   

  

**Mission:** 
 To deliver solutions and experiences that facilitate access to learning and growth for everyone, irrespective of their languages, geographies, abilities, curricula, age groups, learning styles, and socio\-economic status.
   

  

**Education**
 iPrep by iDream Education is a Learning Platform that runs both offline \& online, is bilingual and works on all major hardware devices and operating systems. iPrep delivers curriculum\-aligned digital learning for classes 1st to 12th in English, Hindi, and Regional language mediums for universal reach and learning use as:
   

  

* iPrep Digital Class for Smart Classrooms
* iPrep Digital Library for Tablets/Notebooks based Smart ICT Labs
* iPrep PAL for Personalised Adaptive Learning
* iPrep Tablets for Preloaded Learning Devices with Monitoring
* iPrep App for a one\-stop learning platform across Android, iOS, and Web


 Through iPrep, iDream Education empowers teachers and students, both in schools and at home to
 **Learn Unlimited** 
 .
   

  

 Company website:
 **www.idreameducation.org**
 iPrep website:
 **www.iprep.in**
* Role Summary


 We are looking for an IT Lead — someone who will be the single point of ownership for everything IT at iDream Education. This is not a narrow infrastructure or helpdesk role; it is a domain\-ownership role spanning internal systems, network and cloud infrastructure, our field\-deployed device fleet (iPrep Tablets and other hardware), data security, and compliance.
   

  

 You will be the person who ensures our internal teams never lose a working day to IT friction, and who ensures thousands of devices deployed across schools and NGOs in rural India stay secure, tracked, and functional. You will also be the one building the IT function itself — starting hands\-on, and growing it into a proper team as iDream scales.
   

  

* Key Responsibilities \& Deliverables


**IT Infrastructure, Systems \& Support**
* Own and manage all internal IT infrastructure — networks, servers, cloud services, and systems administration — ensuring uptime, reliability, and security across office operations.
* Run IT helpdesk and support for all employees, ensuring fast turnaround on hardware, software, and access\-related issues.
* Own vendor relationships for hardware, software licenses, ISPs, cloud providers, and AMC contracts — negotiating terms, managing renewals, and controlling IT spend.


**Device \& Field Hardware Fleet Management**
* Own the full lifecycle of iPrep Tablets and other field\-deployed hardware — procurement, provisioning, tracking, maintenance, and end\-of\-life — across schools and NGO locations.
* Build and maintain systems for remote monitoring, troubleshooting, and updates of devices deployed at scale in low\-connectivity environments.
* Coordinate with product and tech teams to ensure hardware compatibility with new iPrep software releases and rollouts.


**Data Security \& Compliance**
* Own information security practices across the organisation — access controls, data backup, endpoint security, and incident response.
* Ensure the organisation's data handling practices align with DPDPA 2023 and other applicable data protection requirements.
* Conduct periodic security audits and risk assessments, and build/maintain IT policies, SOPs, and documentation.


**AI\-First IT Operations:** 
 Bring AI\-augmented workflows into IT operations — from automated monitoring and alerting to AI\-assisted troubleshooting, documentation, and reporting — keeping iDream's IT stack modern and lean.
   

  

* Qualifications \& Experience


**Experience:** 
 5–7 years in IT infrastructure, systems administration, or IT operations, with demonstrable ownership across networks, hardware/device management, and security — ideally including experience managing hardware deployed outside a single office (field, retail, or distributed environments).
   

  

**Sector Context:** 
 Experience in EdTech, the Development sector, or mission\-driven B2B/B2G environments is a strong advantage. Experience managing device fleets in low\-bandwidth or rural contexts is a plus.
   

  

**Technical Proficiency:** 
 Strong grounding in networking, systems administration (Windows/Linux), cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure), and device/MDM (mobile device management) tools.
   

  

**Security \& Compliance:** 
 Working knowledge of IT security fundamentals and data protection principles, including familiarity with DPDPA 2023\.
   

  

**Vendor \& Budget Management:** 
 Proven experience managing vendor contracts, AMC negotiations, and IT budgets.
   

  

**AI Fluency:** 
 You use AI tools as a daily productivity layer for monitoring, troubleshooting, documentation, and reporting — not as a novelty.
   

  

* Key Skills \& Competencies


**What Makes You a Great Fit?**
 You think in systems, not tickets. You've owned IT for an organisation before — not just responded to issues as they came in — and you know how to build infrastructure and processes that scale without breaking. You're equally comfortable troubleshooting a server issue and thinking through how thousands of tablets in rural India stay secure and functional. You're excited about using AI to make IT operations faster and leaner, and you've already started building that into how you work.
   

  

* What We're Looking For — Values \& Culture Fit
* Integrity: Takes ownership of IT infrastructure, security, compliance, and data protection with transparency, accountability, and strong ethical standards.
* Excellence: Builds reliable, secure, scalable, and AI\-enabled IT systems while continuously improving infrastructure, processes, and support.
* Collaboration: Works effectively with internal teams, vendors, and technology partners to ensure seamless IT operations and successful hardware and system deployments.
* Impact: Enables uninterrupted business operations and ensures secure, reliable technology reaches teams, schools, and last\-mile learners at scale.
* Why Join Us


 We are on a mission to take the best of digital learning to every corner of rural Bharat. At iDream, you will have the opportunity to build and own the IT function from the ground up — one that keeps our teams productive and our technology reaching the last\-mile learner securely and reliably.
   

  

* Required Skills (Portal Tags)


 Network Administration, Systems Administration, Cloud Infrastructure, IT Security, Device/MDM Management, Vendor Management, Data Protection Compliance, Decision Making, Analytical Skills
